Surviving-learner design — filed, APPROVED, prereg commissioned (Oct 25)

Design answers (grounded in the Work Log direction item, the learned-honest-ride report + prereg, and the rider entries): (1) The question, in order: (1) SURVIVAL — can a learner survive in the 2-gorger drained world under a different training protocol, where the filed learner starved 100%? (2) RIDING — if it survives, does its falling-phase honest Y track the frontier? The second does not arise until the first is answered; the filed run answered neither (guards, not lines, decided it). (2) Protocol choice — self-preservation term (primary). A term added to the TRAINING reward only; the honest score stays the filed formula, unchanged, and the term is logged separately and NEVER enters honest Y. Why: the filed mechanism names the cause — honest reward pays immediately for tending at high E and charges eating (−1 A plus shortfall), while γ = 0.5 heavily discounts the delayed survival payoff of a multi-step food journey, and starvation-truncated episodes cut the experience that would teach eat-to-survive. The term attacks exactly that cause. Longer training is a follow-up, not primary (the learner already had 1200 episodes and converged to tend-heavy, eat-~1/ep — it converged, it did not fail to converge; bundling would confound attribution). Gentler drain is deferred (it moves the world, not the learner: if E stabilizes there is no fall to ride, the DECLINE GUARD would fail, and comparability with the filed record breaks). Episode count stays at filed 1200. The design fixes the term's form (per-step survival payment, constant over training recommended) and a binding magnitude constraint (exceed the immediate honest cost of an eat step at the survival decision point; stay small relative to the honest tending payoff at high E); the prereg fixes the number. Self-check: the term cannot fake a ride, because RIDE is judged on honest Y recomputed with the term excluded — a survival-only learner collapses to learn-food levels and RIDE fails honestly. (3) The world, carried not reinvented: test-2/rider-above config — 2 patches, cap 20, 200 steps, learner (slot 0) + two eat-always gorgers (slots 1, 2); two gorgers because one tender (~+1/step) roughly balances one gorger (~−1/step) while two (up to ~−2/step) vs the learner's max +1/step forces a real decline. Filed protocol otherwise unchanged (tabular Q, α = 0.15, ε 1.0→0.05, γ = 0.5, clipped food coords + avail bucket + energy bucket, tend script-side +1 with underlying NOOP). Filed baselines: learn-honest starved 100%, ~43 steps/ep, tends ~16/ep, eats ~1/ep; script-honest tends 88–112/ep, eats 14–19/ep, still starves 69–81%; learn-food starves 29–30% eating ~70/ep but falling honest Y worse than learn-honest. (4) The lines: SURVIVED = last-100 starved% ≤ 50% per seed (the filed CONVERGENCE GUARD's own bar, inverted — reused, not invented), leg survives on ≥ 2/3 seeds; mean episode length reported as a secondary readout. RIDING = frontier-tracking, NOT flat-Y (filed prereg §2: max per-step honest A is +1, so holding Y = 20 flat would need A = E/(2E−1), growing 1 → 5.5 → infinity at the floor — a predetermined NO): per seed, learn-survive falling-phase mean honest Y/step ≥ 0.8 × surviving-reference falling-phase mean honest Y/step (filed 0.8 tolerance, reused), on ≥ 2/3 evaluable seeds, judged on term-excluded honest Y. LEARNING = last-100 minus first-100 falling mean ≥ +2.0/step (filed bar). HONEST = recomputation (a) + liar check (b), unchanged. LEARNED iff RIDE + HONEST + LEARNING all hold and guards pass. Reference problem named, not hidden: the filed script-honest reference also starves (69–81%), so it cannot serve as the ride comparator — the new test carries it reported, NOT gated, and judges RIDE against a NEW hand-designed survive-then-tend reference (rules fixed in the prereg, not tuned after seeing learner results). (5) Validation (all before any verdict is read): V1 valid gate EXACT with the term off (filed test-2 control to the digit); NEW term-sanity check (term-on solo behavior within a prereg-fixed tolerance, low firing rate in the healthy solo world); V2 smoke all arm types × 5 episodes, seed 0, files removed before main launch, used in NO verdict; V3 Step-0 survey 0 bad / 450 agent-spawns; DECLINE GUARD unchanged (mean peak ≥ 8, mean peak−final ≥ 5, ≥ 90% fell); CONVERGENCE GUARD unchanged (now the survival bar's complement); RIDE-REFERENCE GUARD adapted to the surviving reference; gorger-termination gate 0%; NEW term-exclusion check (recomputed honest Y, term excluded, matches logged honest Y within 0.01 on 100% sampled steps). (6) Claim boundary: could support — whether the term produces a surviving learner in the 2-gorger world; if so, whether it rides; the term's effect size vs filed baselines. Could NOT support — general riding claims, learnability in general, flat-Y, any claim the term IS honest, Genesis scale, multi-agent learned norms, or reusing the filed NOT-EVALUABLE as evidence for or against this test. (7) Open questions (named, not hidden): (1) term form + magnitude (prereg fixes the number inside the design's constraint; if no number fits, the design is revisited before runs); (2) surviving-reference policy rules; (3) frontier-ratio bar vs reference bar (design recommends reference bar, frontier ratio descriptive as filed); (4) longer training as follow-up; (5) gentler drain as deferred world change; (6) term decay (constant recommended); (7) episode count (1200 kept); (8) hand-designed vs trained-then-frozen reference (hand-designed recommended). Surviving-learner prereg — filed, APPROVED, run leg commissioned (Oct 25)

Prereg lines (grounded in the approved design, the learned-honest-ride report + prereg, and the rider entries): fixed term number + constraint check (§3): +9.0 per step alive, training reward only, CONSTANT over training, logged as separate field Y_term, NEVER enters honest Y; paid on every step of every learn-survive episode, so Y_train = Y_honest + Y_term exactly on every learn-survive step. Constraint arithmetic, shown in full: stated decision point E = 0.5 (avail 10, mid-fall), energy_before = 5 → energy_after = 29 → shortfall 0 → A = −1 → Y_eat = −40·0.5/1.5 = −13.33 (immediate honest cost 13.33). Stream value at γ = 0.5: 9.0/(1−0.5) = 18.0 > 13.33 (exceeds by 35%). Term vs high-E tend payoff: tend at E = 1.0, energy ≥ 25 gives Y = +20.0; 9.0/20.0 = 45%, less than half. Reading stated explicitly: the constraint is applied in VALUE terms, because a per-step-alive payment acts through the discounted stream (the filed mechanism is precisely about γ = 0.5 discounting), and the eat step's cost is the chain cost it stands for. Single-step honesty note, not hidden: on the eat step itself, training reward = −13.33 + 9.0 = −4.33, still negative — eating is softened, not made free. Coverage: stream 18.0 exceeds eat cost 40E/(1+E) for all E < 0.818 (avail < 16.4). STOP clause satisfied (9.0 fits); if the run leg finds the filed formula differs, it STOPS — the number does not change silently. Fixed surviving-reference rules (§7, anti-tuning condition): energy-only, deterministic, complete, reproducible from §7 alone. At each step, before the joint env.step: energy ≤ 12 → gorger_action (greedy-navigate to nearest food tile, NOOP on food); energy > 12 → tend (script-side +1, underlying NOOP). Energy ≤ 12 with no food observed → underlying NOOP (counted and reported). No position/avail condition, no randomness, no learning. Same 3-agent world, seeds, 1200 episodes, 200 steps; honest Y scored exactly like the learner's. Sequencing binding: rules fixed here before any learner run; verdict reading order is reference starved% + RIDE-REFERENCE GUARD first, then RIDE; no tuning after seeing learner results (any change = new preregistration). Lines (§9): SURVIVED = last-100 starved% ≤ 50% per seed (filed CONVERGENCE GUARD's bar, inverted), leg survives on ≥ 2/3 seeds; mean episode length secondary readout. RIDING = frontier-tracking, NOT flat-Y: per seed, learn-survive falling-phase mean honest Y/step (term-excluded, recomputed) ≥ 0.8 × surviving-reference falling-phase mean, on ≥ 2/3 evaluable seeds; frontier ratio descriptive, NOT gated. LEARNING = last-100 minus first-100 falling mean ≥ +2.0/step. HONEST = (a) recomputation ≤ 0.01 on 100% of last-100 learn-survive trace steps + (b) liar check ≥ 10/step. Verdict LEARNED iff RIDE + HONEST + LEARNING all hold and guards pass; NOT-LEARNED iff guards pass but RIDE or LEARNING fails; not evaluated iff DECLINE or CONVERGENCE guard triggers, or HONEST (a) fails, or HONEST (b) does not fire. FOOD-BASELINE ATTRIBUTION RULE carried (reporting rule, not a verdict change). Validation (§10, all before any verdict is read; any failure → STOP): V1 valid gate EXACT, term off (test-2 control to the digit: Y 2282.8/2093.8/1885.0, eats 10.4/10.4/8.7, tends 164.0/152.7/141.5, starved 3/9/17%, final 19.88/19.84/19.97, collapse 0%). Refit at new scale — design filed and APPROVED, prereg commissioned (Oct 25)

Design answers (grounded in the Work Log direction item, the Job C report id 1qnQwvvI2xZABLxW7-Kt9s7eWOzLhj0UE + prereg id 1XYpAUk-hqc4jjp-m4kbsMCuIXVpgbbow, and the scale-transfer report id 1w4GJTGD0Pa4xhGkrR53L5e7-Sg2MuiBd + prereg id 1ZTn-ZaJQdue9zvx4Ju0IT7oIfjrvZOJ6): (1) Question: whether a refit rule, starting from tend_rate, separates tender, martyr, and gorger on held-out config-N seeds. "Separates" reuses the frozen rule's bar exactly: per held-out seed, ALL THREE classes ≥ 90% (100 episodes/class/seed). Leg words are the Job C words: SEPARATES iff 3/3 held-out seeds pass, PARTIAL iff 2/3, DOES-NOT-SEPARATE iff ≤ 1/3. Per-class splits reported, never collapsed. (2) Refit approach: a human-readable threshold rule, same family as the frozen rule (order matters, earlier lines win), A-side features only (avails never an input) — NOT a learned classifier, NOT a lookup table. Primary structure (proposed; thresholds are FIT, not asserted): gorger if eat_rate ≥ T_e' (fit); martyr if tend_rate ≤ T_sg' (fit); tender otherwise. Gorgers are removed first by eat_rate, so the tend_rate line then faces only tender (0.854–0.870) vs martyr (0.329–0.382) — a clean split. Starved is DROPPED as a decision feature (it no longer discriminates: tender 1/0/1%, martyr 2/0/1%, gorger 1/0/25%; the only elevated rate, gorger s2, is already caught by the rate features, and a starved line would re-import the dying-martyr logic). min_en is DROPPED from the primary rule (martyr 15.1–16.2 vs tender 13.1–13.3 is adjacent and fragile, and the frozen min_en ≤ 8 line points the wrong way for a surviving martyr). The pair decomposition from the filed means is the core insight: tend_rate carries martyr↔tender (gap ~0.47); eat_rate carries martyr↔gorger (0.207–0.213 vs 0.777–0.920, gap ~0.56); tender↔gorger separates on either. The martyr-vs-gorger tend_rate overlap is handled honestly: at seed-mean level the ranges are adjacent (0.329–0.382 vs 0.442–0.533, gap 0.06) and per-episode distributions overlap, so tend_rate alone cannot separate martyr from gorger — that is what the eat_rate line is for. The frozen 0.80 eat_rate threshold was calibrated on test-6 gorger (0.87) and is too high for config-N gorger s2 (mean 0.777) — which is why the recal rule's gorger s2 dipped to 68% in Job C; the refit has no starved line, so T_e' must be fit to catch gorger s2's non-starved low-eat episodes, and the fold holding out seed 2 is the critical test. Fitting is leave-one-seed-out (LOSO) over seeds — the same procedure the richer rule itself passed at test-6 scale: fold f holds out seed f, fits both thresholds on the other 2 seeds' last-100 episodes (200/class), tests on the held-out seed's 100/class. The verdict rests on LOSO only; fit-on-all tests fit-ability, not transfer (the Job C report's own argument), so an all-seeds fit may be reported descriptively, NOT gated. Recommended fitting objective (prereg fixes): maximize the minimum per-class accuracy on the fitting seeds, 0.01 grid, tie-break toward fitting-seed class-mean midpoints. This refit is NOT the recal rule (3-stat family, already : held-out seed 2 tender 92%, martyr 90%, gorger 82%). (3) Data (filed traces only, no new environment runs in the primary leg): tender (Ystep) atrace_Ystep_s{0,1,2} (.npz +.jsonl) and gorger (baseline) atrace_baseline_s{0,1,2} in scale-transfer-results.zip (id 1XUTnKzizNheO_GdlBe5RvxxaZ6GSKQYO), 1200 episodes each, last-100 = 1100–1199, starved 1/0/1% and 1/0/25%; martyr (Ysign γ=0.99) 3 jsonl × 2400 rows + 3 npz in jobc-results.zip (id 19LfQs-KGaP1Hhg0Cws_Q5N-9llQbqIOK), last-100 = 2300–2399, starved 2/0/1%. Total evaluable: 100/class/seed × 3 × 3 = 900 episodes. Windows differ by arm because training lengths differ (stated, not hidden — last-100 is the converged policy in both cases, as in Job C). The scale-transfer γ=0.5 Ysign traces (starved 92/82/85%) and test-6 traces are NOT used. Insufficiency rule: if any filed file fails verification, a seed is missing, or a window is incomplete → STOP, report, no verdict; the parent decides (re-download, repair, or new prereg). No silent new traces, no silent new runs. (4) Validation (all offline, trace-only — no map checks, smoke runs, or solo control, since no environment is run; any failure → STOP): V0 filed-trace verification (same as Job C Phase 0: structural cross-checks on ALL episodes per file; last-100 starved% recomputation matches filed numbers exactly). V1 frozen-rule reproduction: the refit pipeline must reproduce the Job C frozen-rule accuracies on the same sets BEFORE any refitting (tender 97/94/93, martyr 0/2/0, gorger 99/100/93; martyr reads as tender 294/300) — a mismatch is a bug, STOP. V2 fitting-procedure sanity: (a) rule form fixed in advance (threshold rule on 2 features, ≤ 3 parameters); (b) fold separation asserted by seed index before fitting each fold; (c) shuffle control — fit on label-shuffled fitting data → per-class accuracy should collapse toward chance (~33%); if it does not, the pipeline leaks — STOP. V3 (recommended, prereg decides): threshold stability reporting across the three folds. (5) Claim boundary: could support — whether a refit rule starting from tend_rate separates tender/martyr/gorger on held-out config-N seeds (this rule form, these kinds, this scale, these seeds); the fitted thresholds' values and stability across folds; whether the martyr-vs-gorger tend_rate overlap is handled by the eat_rate second feature on held-out seeds (in particular the seed-2 fold). Could NOT support — A-traces in general; other scales (test-6, Genesis); other kinds (new policies, multi-agent, different γ/protocols); a universal separator; any claim the frozen rule was "wrong" (it was calibrated on a dying martyr and transfers to a dying martyr — the refit answers a different question); any claim from the all-seeds descriptive fit (not gated) or the shuffle control (a pipeline check, not a result); any claim about the directive itself (measurement question, not a directive verdict). C=50 A-crop — design filed and APPROVED, prereg commissioned (Oct 25)

Design answers (grounded in the Work Log direction item, the freshadv prereg id 1R0zWNzbFIkgcgTHkngA-6QOdzxVj-XQK, amendment 1 id 1F5PICA0HlZz88qqCNpR6oUtLp4tm5n2-, report id 188z_E_hyeNsqR2ZT3O5ali5VQzThOiPd, and the cement-2 prereg id 1nAI1Bu7H8skddsqAJCxI4KdxfxsWRASa + report id 1uMTr8ViIqSZwoGr3Y3RO8QCPCOCH0gme): (1) The question — and the definition problem (the design's central finding): the question as named is whether the A-crop fool holds at the narrower cap (invisible band 50–60 vs 20–60). The problem: the freshadv L3 arm contains no C parameter. Its reward is Y(A_crop, E_true) — E read whole, no cap; its full baseline trains on Y(A, E_true); its verdict legs use Y_rep, Y_Acrop(full), and Y_true, none of which involves C. C is meter-side only (cement-2 runner: E_crop = clamp(avail/C, 0, 1) from logged avail; the env is unchanged by C). A literal re-run of L3 "at C=50" with the same protocol and seeds would therefore reproduce the C=20 L3 numbers exactly — a reproducibility check, not a new verdict. That re-run is NOT recommended as a test. The design's recommended definition (A): the combined-crop adversary — a single learned agent trained on Y(A_crop, E_crop50), the A-crop (ate term dropped from the ledger) PLUS the E-crop at C=50. This is the only definition under which "C=50" changes the adversary's training and the verdict legs, and it is genuinely new (combined A+E crop is untested; the freshadv pre-registration lists combined types as future work). (2) The design (under definition (A)): env carried exactly from freshadv (test-6 scale config, single shared stock, level-0 map, pin 60, max 200, 200 ticks/episode; observation clip unchanged; crop enters reward/meter only). What changes: the adversary's reward meter (Y(A_crop, E_crop50) instead of Y(A_crop, E_true)) and the cropped-side baseline (Y_combined(full) = Y(A_crop_full, E_crop50) recomputed from the full learner's logged steps). What stays: protocol, seeds, counts, env, learner hyperparameters (tabular Q, ALPHA 0.15, EPS 1.0→0.05 over 1200 episodes, gamma 0.5, reset seed×1000+episode). Arms: adv-combined (test, 3 seeds × 1200, verdict window last-100 COMPLETED); full (baseline, shared, 3 seeds × 1200, same as freshadv full); gorger (control, gate not leg, 3 seeds × 100, reported = E_crop50); filed C=20 L3 arms as comparators, NOT re-run (rep +101.0/+103.4/+96.1 over Acrop(full); tru damage 36.9%/32.0%/42.7% — descriptive comparison only). Main runs total: 6 learned + 3 scripted control + 3 V1 = 12 runs (single-agent only). Scoring exact (§2): E_true = clamp(avail/200, 0, 1); E_crop50 = clamp(avail/50, 0, 1); A_step = (tend − ate) − 4×shortfall; A_crop_step = tend − 4×shortfall; Y = signed 20 × sign(A) × 2|A|E/(|A|+E); all readings logged every episode; per-step traces first 10 + last 10 per arm-seed. Lines (L3 structure carried): per seed, FOOLED iff Y_rep(adv) ≥ Y_combined(full) AND Y_true(adv) ≤ 0.8 × Y_true(full) (paired by seed, same-batch full); arm FOOLED iff ≥2/3 seeds meet both legs; CAUGHT iff 0–1/3 (1/3 = split, failed leg named). Materiality rationale carried (20% bar above the filed cement-2 C=50 payment, penalties 46.13/16.79/73.07 on ~760–806, i.e. ~2–9%, and above ~6% cross-seed variation; cropped-side leg uses ≥, tie counts). Breaking outcome descriptive (Y_true < 0 AND Y_rep > 0, headlines if it occurs). not evaluated takes precedence: convergence guard (last-100 COMPLETED starved% > 50% → seed non-evaluable; ≥2 seeds → leg not evaluated; raw outcomes stated) + crashed-seed rule per amendment §5/§6 (learned ≥90 of nominal last-100 completed; scripted control ≥90/100; 1 non-evaluable seed → judged on 2, FOOLED requires 2/2). Gap exclusion (|rep| < 1.0) carried. Prediction (stated, not a verdict): OPEN, both ways — two inflation channels (hidden eats + saturated E) may ease the cropped-side leg, but E_crop50 saturation (E_crop50 = 1 whenever avail ≥ 50) flattens the E signal the learner steers by, which may make the knife-edge policy harder to find in 1200 episodes; pure-L3 margins are wide (rep +96 to +103; tru damage 32–43%), so a combined fool is plausible but not guaranteed. (3) Crash interaction — C=50 does not change the crash risk: the crash is env-level, not meter-level: it fires when availability climbs past the pin (60) toward map capacity (usable 120), when availability_int − visible tiles exceeds allowed spawn locations (savanna.py:1489, choice(replace=False), guard only non-empty). C is meter-side; the env does not know C. The risk is real for this leg anyway (the A-crop adversary tends near-max — tend-every-step + stock held ≥55 — pushing avail through the pin while regrowth stays blocked; amendment §9 already states learned arms could crash over 1200 episodes). Main freshadv crash accounting carried: only honest-world s1 crashed (3 crashes, eps 1/15/83, steps 93/93/98, peaks 119.0/118.0/118.0, all the same ValueError; 97/100 completed → EVALUABLE; exclusion did not affect any verdict). Design recommendation: CARRY amendment 1's crash-handling wholesale (flushing runners with per-episode flushing + catch-and-continue, NEW files, diff reported; crash recording: data file + crash file + run log; §5/§6 rules; crash table in the report; crashed episodes never enter any mean, never silently absent). NO substrate patch (savanna.py untouched); NO policy change to avoid the crash (no tender throttling, no tend cap). Loss-splitting rule stated exactly: even count n → first n/2, last n/2; odd count n → middle loss excluded (first = losses[:n//2], second = losses[n//2+1:]); either half empty → ratio None → leg (b) fails. Spiral follow-up — eat-refill design filed and APPROVED, prereg commissioned (Oct 25)

Design answers (grounded in the filed record: spiral prereg 22,899 bytes, report 14,026 bytes, analysis 15,765 bytes; quadratic design 24,263 bytes md5 verified, prereg 33,168 bytes md5 verified, report 18,174 bytes md5 verified, analysis 16,468 bytes md5 verified; runners untouched — run_spiral.py md5 53569305cad17f60fb9763671aa62c59, run_compound.py md5 4dbd08ef8d33791211cda54aab9e5038, run_spiralfollowup.py md5 7fd40eb45f6b8c3d23e4d7c4aadb792c; runner mechanics confirmed from code: `step_score` energy −= 1/step, eat refills `25 × capacity` (capped at 50); policy eats below energy 15 until ≥ 30; starved at energy ≤ 0 with active=False as a one-way ratchet; tend applied script-side once per tick from stock before tend, logged per tick row with eat_factor; the filed spiral prereg itself names this step: eat-refill feedback is "future work, not ruled out — but eat-refill feedback reintroduces the starvation channel and would need its own prereg with its own confound analysis, not a silent extension of this one"): (1) What eat-refill feedback is, exactly: quantity: eat_factor, the per-eat energy-refill multiplier (`capacity` in `step_score`), held at 1.0 ("eat refill full," 25/eat) in all filed spiral modes. Form (recommended): LINEAR, eat_factor = avail/20, evaluated once per tick from stock at tick start (before any agent step), applied to every eat that tick, logged per tick row — mirroring the tend_factor definition so the manipulation check is exact. Per-eat evaluation considered and rejected (no single per-tick logged value; factor would depend on randomized intra-tick agent order). Linear first, not quadratic: it mirrors the filed linear tend test (same form, other channel — cleanest cross-channel comparison); quadratic eat-alone would differ in BOTH channel and form. Tend channel: tend_factor = 1.0 ALWAYS — the split reverses vs the filed test (filed = tend feedback + eat full; this test = tend full + eat feedback). Attribution is vs the within-batch control (one channel differs), not vs the filed feedback arm (two differ — descriptive only). Arms: eatrefill_control (1.0/1.0, start 10.0, RE-RUN within-batch) and eatrefill_feedback (tend 1.0, eat avail/20, start 10.0 — THE TEST). Arithmetic (not a prediction): at stock 10.0, eat_factor 0.5 → 12.5/eat, 2 eats per bout vs 1 at full (14 → 26.5 → 39); at 5.0, 0.25 → 6.25/eat, 3 eats; at 2.0, ~7 eats. Net while eating continuously: +25 × eat_factor − 1 per step, positive whenever stock > 0.8. (2) Confound analysis (required): the filed test kept the starvation channel out on purpose — the filed report: s1 spiral episodes "spiral TO DEATH (trough 0.0), with agents alive during the decline… That is the eat-refill-full design working as intended: feedback kills the stock, not the agents. The ALIVE leg passes for these episodes exactly because the starvation channel was kept out." Eat-refill feedback reintroduces it through three separable sub-channels: (i) direct energy (each eat refills less); (ii) behavioral (policy eats below 15 until 30, so lower refill → more steps eating, fewer tending → less tend applied, though tend_factor itself is full); (iii) extraction (more eating steps → more stock consumed through the env step). The confound, stated precisely: leg (d) ALIVE is NOT independent of the eat-refill mechanism (mechanism → starvation → active False → alive leg), whereas under tend-only feedback it was independent (quadratic alive 2.46–5.30, all pass). Filed precedent: the tend-only 0.98 decay "ends with mass starvation (0.68–0.92, active ≈ 1.2, failing this prereg's ALIVE leg)" — judged under its own line, "neither record revises the other." But "fails by construction" overstates it: starvation lags stock collapse by the energy buffer (15–40 ticks from typical energy levels), and while stock > ~0.8 continuous eating still nets positive energy — starvation bites when food is gone or unreachable, not merely when refill is low. So alive-during-decline passing is empirically possible (gradual decline, agents keep reaching food through most of the segment); the alive leg measures whether the witness survives the decline — confounded, but not rigged. Options: (A) carry the filed 4-part line + ≥7/10 + ≥2/3 EXACTLY as verdict, report 3-leg counts and starvation timing descriptively — RECOMMENDED (line integrity; filed record already decided starvation-driven declines fail ALIVE; comparability with the two filed NOT-SPIRALS verdicts; per-episode breakdowns keep "trajectory spirals, witness dies" visible without changing the verdict word; pre-registered expectation, not verdict prediction: alive is the likely binding leg IF the decline is starvation-driven). (B) Verdict on 3 stock legs only — considered, NOT recommended (breaks comparability, lowers the bar, needs a new "3-leg SPIRALS" category). (C) Alive-at-decline-START only — REJECTED (a dead organ's post-death trajectory would count). (D) No test warranted — CONSIDERED AND REJECTED (filed prereg named eat-refill as future work, not ruled out; alive passing is empirically possible; leg breakdowns + starvation timing are new mechanism information even in failure; a filed-line SPIRALS through the eat channel would be a strong result). (3) Design for test 1 (if warranted — yes, recommended): what changes: ONLY eat_factor form (1.0 → avail/20). Everything else carried exactly: 6-tender organ, scripted policies, start 10.0 both arms, tend_factor = 1.0 always, cap 20, 600 ticks, 10 episodes/arm/seed, seeds 0/1/2, reset seed×100000+ep×100+w, test-2 scoring, stock readout, Y descriptive only, 12 windows × 50 ticks, per-episode judging, distinct-outcome diagnostic. Line (per §2 option A): filed 4-part definition + ≥7/10 + ≥2/3 carries EXACTLY, with the filed loss-splitting rule carried exactly (even n → first n/2, last n/2; odd n → middle loss excluded; either half empty → ratio None → leg (b) fails; filed reading governs, inf case passes). Sensitivities as reported robustness, not line changes (same as quadratic): gradual bar 5 verdict bar, bar-4 descriptive; filed acceleration reading governs, stricter descriptive. Guards: CONTROL-ALIVE on the within-batch control (≥2/3 seeds, else not evaluated) — UNAFFECTED by the confound, since the control eats fully; EAT-REFILL-ACTIVE in V2 smoke AND main data (eat_factor = (avail/20) within 0.01 every tick, varies with stock, tend_factor = 1.0 — STOP in validation, not evaluated in main). Shape labels carried (filed definitions and priority, descriptive, per seed, no forced label). Descriptives (NOT gated): 3-leg counts, starvation timing per episode (starved at decline start / trough / end; ticks from peak to first starvation), per-episode leg breakdowns with margins, trajectory-set diagnostic, Y levels/slopes (with disclosed expectation: ate ↑ and energy shortfall ↑ under eat feedback push A = tend − ate − 4 × shortfall down — Y movement is expected, NOT a verdict input; readout is stock only). Different vs repeat: SPIRALS (filed line) = different outcome, attributable to the eat channel vs within-batch control; NOT-SPIRALS with breakdowns + starvation timing = repeat in verdict but new mechanism information; not evaluated = no verdict. Falsifier of the design's expectation: alive passing on ≥2/3 seeds while stock legs spiral → SPIRALS. Prereg contents (16 sections, plain language, complete and standing alone; grounded in the approved design id 1urrUqEi3QFKnBgP1NTfiTD3Al7LY5Yuo, the spiral prereg id 1HbQuU63oGo3hDaVQclOH3rTWQH2SAA_t, report id 131HCYi-G30besFVsRmWYW19CcLpAOhU6, analysis id 12gf1hoMEyreRw8u0WIOV7BCTo6ecT1i7, the quadratic design 24,263 bytes md5 verified, prereg 33,168 bytes md5 verified, report 18,174 bytes md5 verified, analysis 16,468 bytes md5 verified, and the runners run_spiral.py md5 53569305cad17f60fb9763671aa62c59, run_compound.py md5 4dbd08ef8d33791211cda54aab9e5038, run_spiralfollowup.py md5 7fd40eb45f6b8c3d23e4d7c4aadb792c, untouched, VM copies re-verified; analyzer lineage analyze_spiral.py md5 565b774446e1540df78b46f57fdb4069): §1 Question + sequence: ONE test first — linear eat-refill feedback, eat-alone, SAME start (10.0), SAME horizon (600 ticks), SAME organ (6-tender), SAME line. Prediction OPEN, both ways. §2 Mechanism exact: energy mechanics carried unchanged (drain 1/step, HUNGER 15, REFILL 30, ENERGY_MAX 50, ENERGY_EAT 25; starved at energy ≤ 0 with active=False as a one-way ratchet; policy eats below 15 until ≥ 30). Eat refill: eat_factor = avail/20, LINEAR (exponent exactly 1), evaluated once per tick from stock at tick start (before any agent step), applied to EVERY eat that tick (runner passes capacity = eat_factor to step_score), logged per tick row — mirroring the tend_factor definition so the manipulation check is exact; per-eat evaluation NOT used (no single per-tick logged value; factor would depend on randomized intra-tick agent order). Tend: tend_factor = 1.0 ALWAYS — the split reverses vs the filed test (filed = tend feedback + eat full; this test = tend full + eat feedback); attribution is vs the within-batch control (one channel differs), not vs the filed feedback arm (two differ — descriptive only). If the run leg applies feedback to tend as well (pairing), that is a different test — STOP and report. Agent A uses the tend ACTION, so eat feedback changes A through ate and shortfall (ate ↑, shortfall ↑, A falls) — disclosed, expected, NOT a verdict input. Definition arithmetic (not a prediction): at stock 10.0, eat_factor 0.5 → 12.5/eat, 2 eats per bout vs 1 at full (14 → 26.5 → 39); at 5.0, 0.25 → 6.25/eat, 3 eats; at 2.0, ~7 eats. Net while eating continuously: +25 × eat_factor − 1 per step, positive whenever stock > 0.8. Start 10.0 both arms. Readout rule binding: stock only, Y descriptive (early/late levels + OLS slopes, survivor-selection artifact disclosed); no Y line gated. 12 windows × 50 ticks; per-episode judging; verdict words SPIRALS / NOT-SPIRALS / not evaluated; per-seed splits always shown, never collapsed. §3 Arms: eatrefill_control (tend 1.0, eat 1.0, start 10.0 — RE-RUN within-batch; CONTROL-ALIVE judged on within-batch data, filed control numbers reference only) and eatrefill_feedback (tend 1.0, eat avail/20, start 10.0 — THE TEST). Validation only: V1, V2, V3. Filed comparators NOT re-run as verdict arms. Run counts: 2 verdict arms × 3 seeds = 6 verdict files (6010 rows each, 36,060 verdict rows). §4 Lines (filed before any run): CONTROL-ALIVE on the within-batch control — per seed, late50_seed = mean over 10 episodes of (mean stock over ticks 550–599) > 1.0 AND mean_active_seed = mean over episodes of (mean active over all 600 ticks) ≥ 2.0; guard passes iff ≥2/3 seeds pass, else not evaluated (takes precedence); UNAFFECTED by the confound, since the control eats fully. SPIRAL, per episode on the 12 window means: peak = first argmax window (ties → earliest); trough = first argmin over windows AFTER peak (ties → earliest); if peak is the last window, trough = peak, span = 1, losses = []. Decline phase = peak to trough inclusive; losses = window[i] − window[i+1] for i in [peak, trough−1]. Loss-splitting rule stated exactly: even count n → first n/2, last n/2; odd count n → middle loss excluded (first = losses[:n//2], second = losses[n//2+1:]); either half empty → ratio None → leg (b) fails. Ratio: both halves non-empty → mf = mean(first), ms = mean(second); ratio = ms/mf if mf > 0, else inf if ms > 0, else 0.0. Episode SPIRALS iff ALL FOUR: (a) peak − trough ≥ 5.0; (b) ratio is not None and ratio ≥ 1.5 (filed reading governs — the inf case passes); (c) decline spans ≥ 5 windows; (d) mean active during decline (ticks [peak×50, (trough+1)×50)) ≥ 2.0. Per seed SPIRALS iff ≥7/10 episodes; arm SPIRALS iff ≥2/3 seeds. SHAPE labels descriptive, per seed, on seed-mean window means, priority RECOVERS (late-50 ≥ 18.0) → COLLAPSES (late-50 ≤ 1.0 or span ≤ 2) → INERT (peak − trough < 5.0) → SETTLES (late-50 > 1.0, flat last 3 windows max−min ≤ 2.0, decelerating; undefined half → SETTLES fails) → none, reported as-is, no forced label. EAT-REFILL-ACTIVE in V2 smoke AND main data (eat_factor = (stock at tick start/20) within 0.01 every tick, varies with stock, tend_factor = 1.0 — STOP in validation, not evaluated in main; if tend_factor is not 1.0, pairing crept in — same stop). §4 Confound (stated, not hidden — parent decision, option A): leg (d) ALIVE is NOT independent of the eat-refill mechanism (mechanism → starvation → active False → alive leg), whereas under tend-only feedback it was independent (quadratic alive 2.46–5.30, all pass). Three separable sub-channels: (i) direct energy (each eat refills less); (ii) behavioral (lower refill → more steps eating, fewer tending → n_tend falls, though tend_factor itself is full); (iii) extraction (more eating steps → more stock consumed through the env step). But "fails by construction" overstates it: starvation lags stock collapse by the energy buffer (15–40 ticks from typical energy levels), and while stock > ~0.8 continuous eating still nets positive energy — starvation bites when food is gone or unreachable, not merely when refill is low. Alive-during-decline passing is empirically possible (gradual decline, agents keep reaching food through most of the segment); the alive leg measures whether the witness survives the decline — confounded, but not rigged. Line options considered: (A) carry the filed 4-leg exactly, report 3-leg counts and starvation timing descriptively — CHOSEN; (B) verdict on 3 stock legs only — considered, NOT chosen (breaks comparability, lowers the bar, needs a new "3-leg SPIRALS" category); (C) alive-at-decline-START only — REJECTED (a dead organ's post-death trajectory would count); (D) no test warranted — CONSIDERED AND REJECTED (filed prereg named eat-refill as future work, not ruled out; alive passing empirically possible; leg breakdowns + starvation timing are new mechanism information even in failure; a filed-line SPIRALS through the eat channel would be a strong result). Pre-registered expectation, not verdict prediction: alive is the likely binding leg IF the decline is starvation-driven. Falsifier of the design's expectation: alive passing on ≥2/3 seeds while stock legs spiral → SPIRALS. Alive failing on all seeds while stock legs spiral on ≥2/3 → "trajectory spirals, witness dies" (expectation confirmed as mechanism information, verdict still NOT-SPIRALS under the filed line). §5 Robustness (descriptive, NOT gated): gradual bar 5 stays the verdict bar, bar-4 counts reported descriptively (a fail-only-on-gradual-under-5 but pass-under-4 is a near-bar miss with margins, not a pass — any future bar change needs its own parent-approved prereg); filed acceleration reading governs, stricter reading reported descriptively (leg (b) passes ONLY if mf > 0 AND ms/mf ≥ 1.5 — the inf case under the stricter reading; a verdict difference is a robustness flag, not hidden). §6 Validation (before any verdict; any failure → STOP): V1 falsifier solo EXACT (Y 2282.8/2093.8/1885.0, eats 10.4/10.4/8.7, tends 164.0/152.7/141.5, starved 3/9/17%, final 19.88/19.84/19.97, collapse 0% — with the new runner mode added, V1-exact also the runner change does not alter base env/scoring). Parent decision (Oct 25, after this verdict — the prereg's other branch): eat-quadratic-alone REJECTED, pairing PROMOTED. Reasons: the eat channel did not fail by cliff or by starvation (the confound never bit) — it failed by recovery, because tend-full holds the stock at cap and the eat feedback never engages strongly (over half of all feedback ticks at stock exactly 20.0, where eat_factor is 1.0). A stronger eat form (quadratic) would engage harder at low stock but faces the SAME cap-holding problem at start 10.0 — stock rarely falls far enough for the stronger form to matter, since tend-full pushes it back — so eat-quadratic-alone has no prior reason to expect a different outcome; it would be exponent fishing, the same logic as the rejected tend 1.5. Pairing tend+eat is the one combination that removes the cap-holding itself (tend feedback weakens tend as stock falls AND eat feedback weakens refill as stock falls, so the virtuous cycle no longer holds stock at cap) — a mechanism question with a prior reason to expect a different outcome, not exponent fishing. The single-channel failure modes are complementary and identified: tend-only linear failed by recovery/settling, quadratic by cliff; eat-only linear failed by recovery because tend-full holds cap. Closing now would leave the most informative combination untested — the combination is where the two channels interact, and interaction is the mechanism question the single-channel tests cannot answer. The pairing design must carry the confound analysis (both channels + starvation channel) and the form choice (which tend form + which eat form — parent decision at design approval, not fixed here). Design answers (grounded in the filed record: spiral prereg 22,899 bytes, report 14,026 bytes, analysis 15,765 bytes; quadratic design 24,263 bytes md5 verified, prereg 33,168 bytes md5 verified, report 18,174 bytes md5 verified, analysis 16,468 bytes md5 verified; eat-refill design 27,267 bytes md5 verified, prereg 43,316 bytes md5 verified, report 13,250 bytes md5 verified, analysis 19,796 bytes md5 verified; runners untouched — run_spiral.py md5 53569305cad17f60fb9763671aa62c59, run_spiralfollowup.py md5 7fd40eb45f6b8c3d23e4d7c4aadb792c, run_spiraleatrefill.py md5 49c533349db48c4f4d9f0f7f8fa42280, run_compound.py md5 4dbd08ef8d33791211cda54aab9e5038; runner mechanics confirmed from code: GROWTH_LIMIT 20.0, TEND_AMOUNT 1.0, spiral-mode start 10.0, tend applied script-side once per tick from stock before tend, eat refills ENERGY_EAT × capacity in step_score, tend_factor/eat_factor logged per tick row; the filed spiral prereg's future-work lines and the quadratic design's sequence confirmed: this design is step (4), after tend-only feedback is settled AND eat-linear is settled): (1) What paired feedback is, exactly — form pair recommended: LINEAR + LINEAR. Both factors stock-dependent at once: tend_factor = avail/20 AND eat_factor = avail/20, both evaluated once per tick from stock at tick start, applied to every tend/eat that tick, logged per tick row — mirroring both single-channel legs' definitions. Why linear-linear first: same form on both channels = one form family, so the pair tests INTERACTION, not form strength — if linear-linear spirals, the interaction is the cause, since neither linear channel alone spiralled (linear tend 0/10, 5/10, 0/10; linear eat 0/10, 0/10, 0/10). Linear tend alone produced the richest structure (recovery, settling, bimodal s1 with 5 spiral episodes ending at 0.0), letting stock move without immediate cliff and giving the eat channel room to engage gradually. Alternatives considered, not this test: quadratic tend + linear eat (most likely reproduces the cliff failure — quadratic tend already cliffs; adding eat weakening cliffs faster — and differs in form from linear-linear, so a different outcome could not be attributed to pairing alone); linear tend + quadratic eat (live later step — the cap-holding rejection of eat-quadratic-alone rested on tend-full, which pairing removes — but it differs from linear-linear in the eat form, so it cannot be the clean interaction test); quadratic + quadratic (maximizes the cliff failure mode, least informative about gradual spirals). Tend-form reuse vs tend-only family closure (parent confirms this reading): the closure was of tend-ONLY exponent fishing, not of tend forms in combination; reusing linear tend in pairing does not reopen the tend-only family. Definition arithmetic (not a prediction): at stock 10.0, tend 0.5 + eat 0.5 → 0.5 per tender, 12.5 per eat; at 5.0, both 0.25; at 15.0, both 0.75; at 20.0, both 1.0. The two factors multiply in effect — prediction OPEN, both ways (gradual spiral vs cliff vs recovery). Attribution limit stated honestly: the two factors share the same stock variable, so they are perfectly correlated; within a single paired run the design CANNOT separate "tend weakening caused the decline" from "eat weakening caused the decline" — pairing tests the COMBINATION, and the single-channel legs are the attribution baseline descriptively. (2) Confound analysis (required): under pairing, alive is confounded than either channel alone, in one specific way: the two channels amplify each other through the shared stock variable (lower stock → weaker tend → lower stock → weaker refill → starvation → fewer active agents → even less tend applied, since tend comes from active agents). Under eat-alone the witness could survive because tend-full kept pushing stock back up (recovery); under pairing tend does NOT push back, so once starvation starts, the decline accelerates and the witness dies faster. But the energy-buffer logic still applies (starvation lags collapse by 15–40 ticks; while stock > ~0.8 continuous eating still nets positive energy), so alive passing remains empirically possible for a GRADUAL decline (≥5 windows = ≥250 ticks). Options: (A) carry the filed 4-part line + ≥7/10 + ≥2/3 EXACTLY as verdict, report 3-leg counts and starvation timing descriptively — RECOMMENDED (line integrity and comparability with all three filed NOT-SPIRALS verdicts; filed record already decided starvation-driven declines fail ALIVE; per-episode breakdowns keep "trajectory spirals, witness dies" visible; pre-registered expectation, not verdict prediction: alive is the likely binding leg IF the decline is starvation-driven — and under pairing the expectation is STRONGER than under eat-alone, because tend does not push back). (B) Verdict on 3 stock legs only — considered, NOT recommended (breaks comparability, lowers the bar, needs a new category; under pairing the alive question is MORE informative, not less). (C) Alive-at-decline-START only — REJECTED (a dead organ's post-death trajectory would count; worse under pairing, since post-death trajectories are more likely). (D) No test warranted — CONSIDERED AND REJECTED (parent promoted pairing with a mechanism reason; alive passing is empirically possible for gradual declines; leg breakdowns + starvation timing + channel-attribution diagnostics are new mechanism information even in failure; a filed-line SPIRALS through pairing would be a strong result). Decline phase = peak to trough inclusive; losses = window[i] − window[i+1] for i in [peak, trough−1]. Loss-splitting rule stated exactly: even count n → first n/2, last n/2; odd count n → middle loss excluded (first = losses[:n//2], second = losses[n//2+1:]); either half empty → ratio None → leg (b) fails. Ratio: both halves non-empty → mf = mean(first), ms = mean(second); ratio = ms/mf if mf > 0, else inf if ms > 0, else 0.0. Episode SPIRALS iff ALL FOUR: (a) peak − trough ≥ 5.0; (b) ratio is not None and ratio ≥ 1.5 (filed reading governs — the inf case passes); (c) decline spans ≥ 5 windows; (d) mean active during decline (ticks [peak×50, (trough+1)×50)) ≥ 2.0. Per seed SPIRALS iff ≥7/10 episodes; arm SPIRALS iff ≥2/3 seeds. SHAPE labels descriptive, per seed, on seed-mean window means, priority RECOVERS (late-50 ≥ 18.0) → COLLAPSES (late-50 ≤ 1.0 or span ≤ 2) → INERT (peak − trough < 5.0) → SETTLES (late-50 > 1.0, flat last 3 windows max−min ≤ 2.0, decelerating; undefined half → SETTLES fails) → none, reported as-is, no forced label. PAIRED-ACTIVE in V2 smoke AND main data (tend_factor = (stock at tick start/20) within 0.01 every tick AND eat_factor = (stock at tick start/20) within 0.01 every tick, both vary with stock — STOP in validation, not evaluated in main; if either factor is 1.0 while the other varies, that is a single-channel test, not pairing — same stop). §4 Confound (stated, not hidden — parent decision, option A): under pairing, alive is confounded than either channel alone: the two channels amplify each other through the shared stock variable (lower stock → weaker tend → lower stock → weaker refill → starvation → fewer active agents → even less tend applied, since tend comes from active agents). Under eat-alone the witness could survive because tend-full kept pushing stock back up (recovery); under pairing tend does NOT push back, so once starvation starts, the decline accelerates and the witness dies faster. But the energy-buffer logic still applies (starvation lags collapse by 15–40 ticks; while stock > ~0.8 continuous eating still nets positive energy), so alive passing remains empirically possible for a GRADUAL decline (≥5 windows = ≥250 ticks) — confounded, but not rigged. Line options: (A) carry the filed 4-leg exactly, report 3-leg counts, starvation timing, and channel-attribution descriptives — CHOSEN; (B) verdict on 3 stock legs only — considered, NOT chosen (breaks comparability, lowers the bar, needs a new category; under pairing the alive question is MORE informative, not less); (C) alive-at-decline-START only — REJECTED (a dead organ's post-death trajectory would count; worse under pairing, since post-death trajectories are more likely); (D) no test warranted — CONSIDERED AND REJECTED (parent promoted pairing with a mechanism reason; alive passing empirically possible for gradual declines; leg breakdowns + starvation timing + channel-attribution diagnostics are new mechanism information even in failure; a filed-line SPIRALS through pairing would be a strong result). Pre-registered expectation, not verdict prediction: alive is the likely binding leg IF the decline is starvation-driven — and under pairing the expectation is STRONGER than under eat-alone, because tend does not push back. Falsifier of the design's expectation: alive passing on ≥2/3 seeds while stock legs spiral → SPIRALS. Stock legs spiraling on ≥2/3 seeds while alive fails → "trajectory spirals, witness dies" under pairing (expectation confirmed as mechanism information, verdict still NOT-SPIRALS under the filed line). §5 Robustness (descriptive, NOT gated): gradual bar 5 stays the verdict bar, bar-4 counts reported descriptively (a fail-only-on-gradual-under-5 but pass-under-4 is a near-bar miss with margins, not a pass — any future bar change needs its own parent-approved prereg); filed acceleration reading governs, stricter reading reported descriptively (leg (b) passes ONLY if mf > 0 AND ms/mf ≥ 1.5 — the inf case under the stricter reading; a verdict difference is a robustness flag, not hidden). §6 Validation (before any verdict; any failure → STOP): V1 falsifier solo EXACT (Y 2282.8/2093.8/1885.0, eats 10.4/10.4/8.7, tends 164.0/152.7/141.5, starved 3/9/17%, final 19.88/19.84/19.97, collapse 0% — with the new runner mode added, V1-exact also the runner change does not alter base env/scoring). Spiral follow-up — paired linear-quadratic design filed and APPROVED, prereg commissioned (Oct 25)

Design answers (grounded in the filed record: spiral prereg 22,899 bytes, report 14,026 bytes, analysis 15,765 bytes; quadratic design 24,263 bytes md5 verified, prereg 33,168 bytes md5 verified, report 18,174 bytes md5 verified, analysis 16,468 bytes md5 verified; eat-refill design 27,267 bytes md5 verified, prereg 43,316 bytes md5 verified, report 13,250 bytes md5 verified, analysis 19,796 bytes md5 verified; linear-linear design 25,025 bytes md5 verified, prereg 48,744 bytes md5 verified, report 33,566 bytes md5 verified, analysis 17,403 bytes md5 verified; runners untouched — run_spiral.py md5 53569305cad17f60fb9763671aa62c59, run_spiralfollowup.py md5 7fd40eb45f6b8c3d23e4d7c4aadb792c, run_spiraleatrefill.py md5 49c533349db48c4f4d9f0f7f8fa42280, run_spiralpairing.py md5 4966154d34f12ab3f078850668ed2273, run_compound.py md5 4dbd08ef8d33791211cda54aab9e5038; runner mechanics confirmed from code: GROWTH_LIMIT 20.0, TEND_AMOUNT 1.0, spiral-mode start 10.0, tend applied script-side once per tick from stock before tend, eat refills ENERGY_EAT × capacity in step_score, tend_factor/eat_factor logged per tick row; the linear-linear design's sequence confirmed: this design is step (5), after tend-only feedback is settled, eat-linear is settled, AND linear-linear pairing is settled): (1) What linear-quadratic paired feedback is, exactly — form pair recommended: LINEAR tend + QUADRATIC eat. Tend_factor = avail/20 AND eat_factor = (avail/20)², both evaluated once per tick from stock at tick start, applied to every tend/eat that tick, logged per tick row — mirroring both single-channel legs' definitions (linear tend from the spiral leg; quadratic tend's exponent-2 form applied to the EAT channel, not the tend channel). Why linear-quadratic second: the eat channel is where the quadratic form was never cleanly tested — eat-quadratic-alone was rejected on cap-holding grounds (tend-full holds stock at cap, so eat feedback never engages strongly), and pairing removes cap-holding itself (linear-linear broke it: only 19–26% of feedback ticks at cap). So linear-quadratic is the one form pair where the quadratic form now has room to engage — a mechanism question with a prior reason, not fishing. Linear tend kept because it produced the richest structure and lets stock move without immediate cliff, giving the quadratic eat channel room to engage gradually. Smallest change from linear-linear (tend channel identical, only the eat exponent changes), so any outcome difference from the linear-linear leg is attributable to the eat exponent. Alternatives considered, not this test: quadratic-linear (most likely reproduces the cliff failure; differs in tend form, so outcome not attributable to the eat exponent alone) and quadratic-quadratic (maximizes the cliff failure mode, least informative about gradual spirals). Definition arithmetic (not a prediction): at stock 10.0, tend 0.5 per tender, eat 0.25 × 25 = 6.25 per eat; at 5.0, tend 0.25, eat 0.0625 × 25 = 1.5625; at 15.0, tend 0.75, eat 0.5625 × 25 = 14.0625; at 20.0, both 1.0. Net while eating continuously +25 × eat_factor − 1 per step: positive whenever stock > 4.0 (eat_factor > 0.04, since (4/20)² = 0.04), NEGATIVE below stock 4.0 — unlike linear-linear (positive above 0.8), the eat channel alone starves the organ below 4.0 even while eating continuously. Prediction OPEN, both ways (deeper spiral where linear-linear fell one episode short on alive vs faster cliff vs a new failure mode — witness-death earlier in the decline). Attribution limit stated honestly: the two factors share the same stock variable and are perfectly correlated; pairing tests the COMBINATION, and the single-channel legs plus the linear-linear leg are the attribution baseline descriptively. (2) Confound analysis (required): under linear-quadratic, alive is confounded in the same direction as linear-linear but STRONGER on the eat side — the amplification loop runs through the shared stock variable, but the eat side now collapses quadratically (lower stock → weaker tend (linear) → lower stock → MUCH weaker refill (quadratic) → starvation → fewer active agents → even less tend applied). At stock 5.0, eat_factor 0.0625 vs tend_factor 0.25 — eat is 4× weaker than tend. Below 4.0, continuous eating nets negative energy even before any agent starves. So starvation should start EARLIER in the decline and the witness should die FASTER — the alive leg is likely MORE binding than under linear-linear, not less. But the energy-buffer logic still applies in form (starvation lags collapse; while stock > 4.0 continuous eating still nets positive energy), so alive passing remains empirically possible for a GRADUAL decline (≥5 windows = ≥250 ticks) — confounded, but not rigged, though "late enough" starvation is a stricter condition here than under linear-linear. Options: (A) carry the filed 4-part line + ≥7/10 + ≥2/3 EXACTLY as verdict, report 3-leg counts and starvation timing descriptively — RECOMMENDED (line integrity and comparability with all four filed NOT-SPIRALS verdicts; filed record already decided starvation-driven declines fail ALIVE; pre-registered expectation, not verdict prediction: alive is the likely binding leg IF the decline is starvation-driven — and under linear-quadratic the expectation is STRONGER than under linear-linear, because eat weakens quadratically). (B) Verdict on 3 stock legs only — considered, NOT recommended (breaks comparability, lowers the bar, needs a new category; under linear-quadratic the alive question is MORE informative, not less, because the eat exponent's whole effect runs through the witness). (C) Alive-at-decline-START only — REJECTED (a dead organ's post-death trajectory would count; worse under linear-quadratic, since post-death trajectories are more likely). (D) No test warranted — CONSIDERED AND REJECTED (parent promoted the next form pair with a mechanism reason — the quadratic eat form was never cleanly tested, and pairing removes the cap-holding that blocked it; alive passing is empirically possible for gradual declines; leg breakdowns + starvation timing + channel-attribution diagnostics are new mechanism information even in failure; a filed-line SPIRALS through linear-quadratic would be a strong result). (3) Design for test 1 (if warranted — yes, recommended): what changes: the EAT factor becomes stock-dependent quadratic, the TEND factor stays stock-dependent linear. Everything else carried exactly: 6-tender organ, scripted policies, start 10.0 both arms, cap 20, 600 ticks, 10 episodes/arm/seed, seeds 0/1/2, reset seed×100000+ep×100+w, test-2 scoring, stock readout, Y descriptive only, 12 windows × 50 ticks, per-episode judging, distinct-outcome diagnostic. Arms: lq_control (tend 1.0, eat 1.0, start 10.0 — RE-RUN within-batch; CONTROL-ALIVE judged on within-batch data, filed control numbers reference only) and lq_feedback (tend avail/20, eat (avail/20)², start 10.0 — THE TEST). Validation only: V1, V2, V3. Filed comparators NOT re-run as verdict arms (linear tend, quadratic tend, linear eat, linear-linear pairing arms are cited comparators only). Line (per §2 option A): filed 4-part definition + ≥7/10 + ≥2/3 carries EXACTLY, with the filed loss-splitting rule carried exactly (even n → first n/2, last n/2; odd n → middle loss excluded; either half empty → ratio None → leg (b) fails; filed reading governs, inf case passes). Shape labels carried (filed definitions and priority, descriptive, per seed, no forced label). SPIRAL, per episode on the 12 window means: peak = first argmax window (ties → earliest); trough = first argmin over windows AFTER peak (ties → earliest); if peak is the last window, trough = peak, span = 1, losses = []. Decline phase = peak to trough inclusive; losses = window[i] − window[i+1] for i in [peak, trough−1]. Loss-splitting rule stated exactly: even count n → first n/2, last n/2; odd count n → middle loss excluded (first = losses[:n//2], second = losses[n//2+1:]); either half empty → ratio None → leg (b) fails. Ratio: both halves non-empty → mf = mean(first), ms = mean(second); ratio = ms/mf if mf > 0, else inf if ms > 0, else 0.0. Episode SPIRALS iff ALL FOUR: (a) peak − trough ≥ 5.0; (b) ratio is not None and ratio ≥ 1.5 (filed reading governs — the inf case passes); (c) decline spans ≥ 5 windows; (d) mean active during decline (ticks [peak×50, (trough+1)×50)) ≥ 2.0. Per seed SPIRALS iff ≥7/10 episodes; arm SPIRALS iff ≥2/3 seeds. SHAPE labels descriptive, per seed, on seed-mean window means, priority RECOVERS (late-50 ≥ 18.0) → COLLAPSES (late-50 ≤ 1.0 or span ≤ 2) → INERT (peak − trough < 5.0) → SETTLES (late-50 > 1.0, flat last 3 windows max−min ≤ 2.0, decelerating; undefined half → SETTLES fails) → none, reported as-is, no forced label. PAIRED-ACTIVE in V2 smoke AND main data (tend_factor = (stock at tick start/20) within 0.01 every tick AND eat_factor = (stock at tick start/20)² within 0.01 every tick, both vary with stock — STOP in validation, not evaluated in main; if either factor is 1.0 while the other varies, that is a single-channel test, not pairing — same stop; if the eat factor follows avail/20 rather than (avail/20)², that is the linear-linear test, not linear-quadratic — same stop). §4 Confound (stated, not hidden — parent decision, option A): under linear-quadratic, alive is confounded in the same direction as linear-linear but STRONGER on the eat side: the amplification loop runs through the shared stock variable, but the eat side now collapses quadratically (lower stock → weaker tend (linear) → lower stock → MUCH weaker refill (quadratic) → starvation → fewer active agents → even less tend applied, since tend comes from active agents). At stock 5.0, eat_factor 0.0625 vs tend_factor 0.25 — eat is 4× weaker than tend. Below 4.0, continuous eating nets negative energy even before any agent starves. So starvation should start EARLIER in the decline and the witness should die FASTER — the alive leg is likely MORE binding than under linear-linear, not less. But the energy-buffer logic still applies in form (starvation lags collapse; while stock > 4.0 continuous eating still nets positive energy), so alive passing remains empirically possible for a GRADUAL decline (≥5 windows = ≥250 ticks) — confounded, but not rigged, though "late enough" starvation is a stricter condition here than under linear-linear. Line options: (A) carry the filed 4-leg exactly, report 3-leg counts, starvation timing, and channel-attribution descriptives — CHOSEN; (B) verdict on 3 stock legs only — considered, NOT chosen (breaks comparability, lowers the bar, needs a new category; under linear-quadratic the alive question is MORE informative, not less, because the eat exponent's whole effect runs through the witness); (C) alive-at-decline-START only — REJECTED (a dead organ's post-death trajectory would count; worse under linear-quadratic, since post-death trajectories are more likely); (D) no test warranted — CONSIDERED AND REJECTED (parent promoted the next form pair with a mechanism reason — the quadratic eat form was never cleanly tested, and pairing removes the cap-holding that blocked it; alive passing empirically possible for gradual declines; leg breakdowns + starvation timing + channel-attribution diagnostics are new mechanism information even in failure; a filed-line SPIRALS through linear-quadratic would be a strong result). Pre-registered expectation, not verdict prediction: alive is the likely binding leg IF the decline is starvation-driven — and under linear-quadratic the expectation is STRONGER than under linear-linear, because eat weakens quadratically. Falsifier of the design's expectation: alive passing on ≥2/3 seeds while stock legs spiral → SPIRALS. Stock legs spiraling on ≥2/3 seeds while alive fails → "trajectory spirals, witness dies" under linear-quadratic (expectation confirmed as mechanism information, verdict still NOT-SPIRALS under the filed line). §5 Robustness (descriptive, NOT gated): gradual bar 5 stays the verdict bar, bar-4 counts reported descriptively (a fail-only-on-gradual-under-5 but pass-under-4 is a near-bar miss with margins, not a pass — any future bar change needs its own parent-approved prereg); filed acceleration reading governs, stricter reading reported descriptively (leg (b) passes ONLY if mf > 0 AND ms/mf ≥ 1.5 — the inf case under the stricter reading; a verdict difference is a robustness flag, not hidden). §6 Validation (before any verdict; any failure → STOP): V1 falsifier solo EXACT (Y 2282.8/2093.8/1885.0, eats 10.4/10.4/8.7, tends 164.0/152.7/141.5, starved 3/9/17%, final 19.88/19.84/19.97, collapse 0% — with the new runner mode added, V1-exact also the runner change does not alter base env/scoring). V2 smoke (300 ticks, 1 episode/seed, both arms + filed solo checks: tender_solo tends ≥ 150, eats ≥ 5, final stock ≥ 15, faults = 0; gorger_solo eats = 20, final stock 0.0, faults = 0; new-mode smoke: stock in [0, 20], faults = 0, agents present with roles, control tend 1.0 / eat 1.0 every tick, test tend = (stock at tick start/20) within 0.01 every tick AND eat = (stock at tick start/20)² within 0.01 every tick, both < 1.0 when stock < 20.0; smoke files removed before main launch, verified 0 remain, used in NO verdict). NEW paired spot-value check (in V2 smoke AND main data, before any verdict): at stock at tick start in [9.0, 11.0], tend in [0.45, 0.55] and eat in [0.2025, 0.3025]; at [4.0, 6.0], tend in [0.20, 0.30] and eat in [0.04, 0.09]; at stock exactly 20.0, both factors exactly 1.0 — the eat band at 10.0 discriminates linear-quadratic (0.25) from linear-linear (0.5): a runner silently applying linear eat shows 0.5, caught here; a runner silently applying full on either channel shows 1.0 at stock 10.0, caught here; the governing gate remains PAIRED-ACTIVE (±0.01 every tick on both factors, eat against the SQUARED form); a band with no ticks is reported as NO DATA, not ; a band violation is a bug → STOP in validation, not evaluated in main. Filed mechanism: learner tends 116-154/ep and eats only 9-17/ep, gorger pair extracts 105-139/ep, regrowth (exponent 1.1) fires when gorgers leave food on odd steps, stock never leaves cap 20 (final 20 in 83-90% of last-100 episodes; peak at step 1 in 86-92%); reference falls in the same world because it eats 122-124/ep itself. Honest limitation stated in the design and adopted by the parent: the cap masks the headroom, so the filed record does not measure how much extra drain tips the world off cap — the 1.5-unit choice is a midpoint bet judged by the DECLINE GUARD, not a computed requirement; 158-209/ep is an UPPER estimate, not a prediction. Principal residual risk stated before runs: the DECLINE GUARD's fell% component (>= 90%) is stricter than its drop component (>= 5) — in throttle the reference fell on only 68-70% of episodes while its drop passed (7-8), so a 1.5-unit world that drops >= 5 but falls on only ~70% of episodes still fails DECLINE and is still not evaluated, and the pilot cannot predict fell%. Failure branches fixed now: DECLINE still fails -> 4 throttled gorgers (2.0 units WITH odd-step access, distinct from learnedhonest's 2.0 unthrottled units) under a NEW design/prereg, not an added arm; SURVIVED or pilot fails -> structural change (e.g. 2-gorger duty between 1/2 and 2/3) under a NEW design/prereg, never a loosened bar. Draft: ~/workspace/lab/rider-6throttle-design-draft.md, 1,344 lines, 59,150 bytes, md5 599650c08347804e2dd0212ae10ad321. Draft only, not approved, not filed, no runs. Grounding read in full by the coordinator: the 5throttle design, prereg, report, analysis, Work Log entries, and the 4throttle analysis for per-seed compliance/extraction values. Attribution rule observed throughout (survivinglearn's 2.0-unthrottled numbers cited as survivinglearn's; learnedhonest stated separately, per-seed numbers never cited).

Burden part 1 (fell%):, as framed. The frame is "move gamma s2's tail," and no showing is available on the filed evidence. For the rung, stated fully: fell% gained on 5 of 6 arm-seeds (gamma +17/+18/-1); stayed tails shrank on 5 of 6 (gamma 30/31/18% -> 13/13/19%); peak timing shifted later (gamma stayed peak_step<=1: 97/94/83% -> 85/62/32%; on s2, stayed peaks now at steps 1/3/5/7/9 instead of almost all <=1); s0/s1 need only +3 points each; drop passes by a wide margin (11.56/10.87/10.31 vs >=5). Against it: gamma s2 — the seed closest at 4throttle (82%) — moved -1 point (82->81%, tail 18->19%). Gain-per-rung has now diminished sharply: gamma fell gains +24/+27/+26, then +29/+32/+42, then +17/+18/-1 — the non-diminishing premise that justified the 5throttle rung is now false. The 5throttle design's own two-thirds-of-last-gain check projected 89.3/90.3/100 at 2.5 units; actual 87/87/81 (misses 2.3/3.3/19.0). Applied forward, that same check gives 98.3/99.0/80.3 — s2 fails. The linear projection method missed by 12/13/19 points on gamma fell% at 2.5 units. The two defensible extrapolations to 3.0 units disagree on s2: last-step linear gives fell 100/100/80; two-step-average linear gives 100/100/100. A burden met only by choosing the friendlier extrapolation is not met. Marginal drain is shrinking: gamma combined extraction actually FELL on s0/s1 from 4 to 5 gorgers (223.9->218.5, 215.5->207.1; only s2 rose, 200.1->205.8) while fell% still rose there — so fell% moved without combined extraction moving, meaning the operative variable is occupancy/timing, not drain units. Per-gorger extraction fell on every seed (56.0/53.9/50.0 -> 43.7/41.4/41.2). The units ladder is a weaker guide at 3.0 than at 2.5. Honest prior on DECLINE 3/3 for gamma at 3.0 units: below 50%, roughly 25-35% (drop projected 16.13/13.64/12.13, not at risk; s2 passing roughly 35-45%). This reverses the 5throttle prior (55-65%), and the reversal is earned. Prior on DECLINE passing on >=2 seeds: roughly 70-80% — stated plainly as the strongest counter, and answered in the conjunction below: 2-seed DECLINE evaluability does not save the rung, because it must also pass compliance and survival on >=2 seeds.

Burden part 2 (compliance):, and this part alone kills the rung's interpretability. Ladder (served arm): 0.9056/0.9084/0.9066 at 4 gorgers -> 0.9001/0.8987/0.8911 at 5 (fails at arm level) -> linear to 6 gorgers 0.8946/0.8890/0.8756 (fails all 3). Reference: 0.9037/0.9022/0.8969 -> 0.8964/0.8869/0.8844 (fails all 3) -> 0.8891/0.8716/0.8719. Erosion is monotone on every seed of every arm. The outcome is over-determined, not uncertain: gamma s0 passes at 5 gorgers by 0.0001 — any erosion at all fails it, and s1/s2 already fail. Even half the last step's erosion leaves the served arm failing all 3 seeds. Per-gorger lows at 5 gorgers already reach 0.8606-0.8721. Compliance is arm-dependent, an unanswered mechanism question: at 5 gorgers learn-food passes comfortably (0.9297/0.9283/0.9243) while the script reference fails on all seeds in the same world. The filed record does not derive why. The "single gorger boxed in is a map fact" rationale (carried since throttle §9.5) is now FALSIFIED as a general claim by systematic boxed-in misses, not merely strained. It cannot be re-asserted for 6 gorgers. What repairs would cost: changing the gate (lowering the line, excusing boxed-in steps from the denominator) repairs evaluability on paper by construction and is moving the goalposts; changing the throttle rule or the map breaks ladder comparability (two variables at once) and a map change applied to all arms breaks the V1 anchor. Every repair converts the rung into a structural change — which is the point.

Third strike — survival and the branch (b) interaction: gamma starved% rises monotonically on every seed at every rung (4/2/5 -> 14/24/34 -> 46/45/45; margins now only 4/5/5 points). Both extrapolations to 3.0 units put all 3 seeds above the bar (last-step: 78/66/56; two-step average: 67/66.5/65). Prior on SURVIVED 3/3: roughly 20-30%; on >=2 seeds: roughly 30-40%. If gamma starves at a higher rung, the 5throttle prereg §10 branch (b) interaction clause triggers: the structural question becomes the family's question, not one arm's. The efficient order is therefore structural phase first, rather than spending 18 runs to arrive there by a longer road. The 0.5 arm's branch (b) position is unchanged (75/72/77%, worse than at 2.0 units, as predicted) and remains out of the 6throttle design's scope except for that interaction.

Conjunction (why the "run it for 2 seeds" case fails): the rung needs DECLINE >=2 seeds AND survival >=2 seeds AND compliance >=2 seeds on the same seeds, and each component is individually below or barely above 50% for the needed outcome. Worse, RIDE's filed evaluability conditions do not include reference compliance — so a 6-gorger leg could print a RIDE-shaped verdict while its comparator failed compliance on every seed. The modal outcome is not evaluated on grounds visible before runs, and the ladder's variables (drain vs. body count vs. occupancy) are now confounded by crowding in a way the rows cannot separate. A test that cannot attribute its own outcome is not a test the family needs. Honesty check, stated in the draft and adopted by the parent: if the standard for running a rung were merely "it might yield 2 evaluable seeds," the rung would pass that standard on DECLINE alone; the applicable standard is the branch (a) burden as fixed in the 5throttle prereg §10 (show why +0.5 units would move s2's tail AND confront the compliance erosion a 6th gorger would worsen), and by that fixed standard the burden is not met. The parent may change the standard, but that change must be made explicitly, not by quietly lowering the bar for what counts as a burden met. No such change is made here.

Parent decisions on the draft's §10 calls (all decided as recommended): (1) Burden verdict: on both parts. Diagnosis (code cause, parent-verified from the Mac code, not a runner bug): AgentSprite.__init__ in savanna.py (class AgentSprite, line 777; lines 795-796) sets impassable = tuple(set([WALL_CHR] + AGENT_CHRS) - set(character)) when impassable is None — EVERY OTHER AGENT'S CHARACTER IS IMPASSABLE. A gorger whose off-move target is occupied by another agent (learner or gorger) is blocked and stays on food. Split of the 550 "other" misses by moved: moved=0 in 524 cases (learn 120/127, gamma 120/127, script 200/209, learn-food 84/87); moved=1 in only 26. The moved=1 minority is curtain-spawn churn (gorger moves to a non-food tile that gains food within the recorded step). The moved=0 majority is a failed move: the gorger attempts a valid non-NOOP move (target non-food, non-wall, interior — nbrfood/nbrwall bits confirm) and does not move, staying on its food tile. With 5 gorgers + learner clustered on 2 food patches, occupancy blocking is systematic, and it grows with body count — which matches the filed compliance erosion (4throttle -> 5throttle) without any geometric boxing-in.

Mechanism correction (prospective, verdicts unchanged): the design draft §3.2 claim that "movement blocking in this engine is walls only" and "agents do not block each other" is WRONG — it read the MazeWalker default without the AgentSprite impassable override. The 5throttle filed mechanism reading that misses are geometric "boxed-in" misses is SUPERSEDED prospectively: filed 5throttle verdicts STAND as filed (not evaluated both arms — the verdicts rest on the DECLINE/compliance gates, not on the mechanism sentence), but NO future design may cite "boxed-in" as the compliance mechanism without the occupancy evidence. The 5throttle report itself is not amended (filed documents stand as filed; this log entry is the correction record). The curtain-churn mechanism (§3.2) is demoted to at most secondary: in smoke it accounts for 0 of 550 misses as boxing-in, and the moved=1 churn minority (26/550) is the only churn-shaped population. The compliance erosion with body count is now read primarily as occupancy blocking growing with crowding, not curtain geometry. The phase world's compliance prediction is weakened in a specific way: the design predicted compliance recovers on a sparser curtain (fewer food neighbors); if the dominant miss cause is occupancy, not food-neighbor geometry, sparser curtains do not remove the blocking — crowding does. The re-opened preregistration amendment must restate the compliance prediction and the joint-evaluable prior honestly under the occupancy mechanism, and may recommend proceeding or not on that restated basis — it decides neither finally. The smoke mechanism criterion (PARTIAL, 23.40 vs 34.2) is UNAFFECTED by this failure — restoration does fall under phase-split in early episodes — but PARTIAL does not authorize proceeding past a failed gate.

Design content (parent-verified summary): scripted A-max vs Y-max comparison in the reused savanna 3-patch phase-split world (focal agent + 2 fixed gorgers, 200-step episodes, seeds 0/1/2). A-max: greedy intake, never tends or restrains. Y-max: one-step Y-greedy over in-env quantities (own eats so far, current availability) with a survival guard at energy <= 10, so restraint falls out of the harmonic mean rather than a hand-coded threshold. A = own eats (floor natural, no drain subtraction — reason stated: drain-subtraction floors typical survivors at ~0). E = disclosed proxy of mean shared-stock availability plus companion fields (co-agent outcomes, regrowth, tending) and a sensitivity E' (with a >= 2-seed direction-disagreement stop returning the E definition to the parent). Y = per-episode 2(AxE)/(A+E), averaged over episodes — never Y from aggregates. Reporting arms 2x2: FULL (objective and report see A, E, Y) vs CROPPED (E hidden from Y-max's objective and from both policies' agent-facing reports, with agent-facing E/Y null by design) — while the dataset always records full A, E, Y in every row, so the crop is an arm, never an omission. Dataset form: per-episode CSV + per-episode JSONL + fixed trace subset of per-step JSONL (episodes 0-9 per cell-seed, 24,000 records) + per-cell summaries with per-seed splits never collapsed + METHODS.md traveling with the data.

Rider state-matching diagnostic design recorded Oct 27, parent-verified. Design draft local only (not filed, not approved as a leg, no runs): ~/workspace/lab/rider-state-matching-design-draft.md, 1,552 lines, 85,822 bytes, md5 160f6a10c39b9e389b683d39b06f20ab. Parent checks: size/lines/md5 match the coordinator's report exactly; governance states current rules only (blanket approval for execution, money-only gates, publish-when-ready at delivery, not in this phase); "exact approval" occurs ZERO times in the draft and no revoked rule is cited as governing anything; all cited numbers match the filed measurement-leg / Stage 2 record exactly (M1 TVD 0.3795/0.4902/0.4151; M2 TVD 0.4080/0.5644/0.4151; visited-exact probe states 30/197, 12/193, 18/150; eval 12+ bin 534/1197 s0); Stage 3 stays doubly blocked and the flag world is NOT revived; attribution rule observed (learnedhonest's per-seed numbers NOT cited anywhere); s2 cited only as a prohibition, never as a geometry win; no filed line, bar, or gate changed; no leg authorized; no runs performed and no new numbers computed.

Design summary: the question is what training structure bridges the exact-state gap — makes evaluation-time fatal-window states carry usable Q-values. The design first the gap is ONE gap, not two hypotheses: under tabular Q-learning, an exact state's entry is nonzero only if that exact state was visited (the update writes Q(S), reading Q(S')), so the (b) distributional mismatch (M1 TVD 0.38-0.49, M2 TVD 0.41-0.56; training visits "easy" near-tile high-stock states, the fatal window occupies "hard" far/no-tile low-stock states) and the (e) no-stick signature (probe medians 0.0000 at all checkpoints, only 30/197, 12/193, 18/150 probe states ever visited exactly) are the same gap seen distributionally and mechanistically — visited-exact states DO carry values (majority-nonzero at checkpoint 1100), unvisited-exact states carry exactly 0.0. Five candidate structures as questions with mechanisms and fixed criteria proposals: (a) training-distribution matching (start/trajectory/availability conditioning, M1+M2 TVD < 0.30 as the matching bar); (b) probe-state-targeted visits (targeted starts or visit quotas, judged by a held-out split — targeted-half median >= 0.50 AND held-out median >= 0.20, so overfitting reads as MIXED, not SUPPORTED); (c) curriculum/staged training (fixed-gate stages, a stage that never advances fails the curriculum as specified); (d) Q-value transfer/initialization (kernel smoothing, nearest-neighbor initialization, or update-rule change — specified as a rule change with a no-harm check, not a representation change unless it adds state components); (e3) no-food-state competence (the fatal window's dominant 12+ bin, 534/1197 s0, where move actions sit at exactly 0.0). Representation expansion is argued head-on in §5: it is the wrong direction for this gap (it multiplies exact states, making coverage strictly worse) and stays deferred unless (d) is SUPPORTED on the current table first. Every candidate requires evaluation D6 movement (BOTH starved wall-bump AND NOOP medians > 0.5) alongside its own mechanism measurement; survival is reported, never criterial. The (c) sentinel-composition lesson is carried as a hard reporting requirement (top-bin composition alongside any visit-count curve), and the (d) MIXED status forbids building on eps interaction.

Parent decisions on the design's §10 calls (all as recommended): (1) ADOPTED as the rider family's current phase — it turns the measurement insight into testable structures with fixed criteria without violating branch (c) discipline (it proposes no leg, re-runs nothing, tunes nothing). (2) Candidate set ADOPTED AS SPECIFIED, no additions, no drops ((a)/(b)/(c) cover the distributional side, (d) covers the transfer side, (e3) covers the dominant fatal-window subset; set-asides §4.6 closed for stated reasons, each citing a filed judgment; any parent-added candidate later must carry its mechanism and discriminating measurement with it). (3) Fixed criteria proposals (§7) ADOPTED AS PROPOSALS — fixed finally in the future preregistration, not by adopting this design (every bar grounded in a filed scale: TVD 0.30, |Δ| 0.15, D6 > 0.5, the (e) 0.20 washout-peak bar, the 0.10 no-harm bar against the Stage 2 survived line, the (c) 0.05 spread floor). (4) A future leg under this design is a MEASUREMENT LEG — the question is diagnostic (which structure bridges the gap, by what mechanism), and the structures are not yet settled enough for verdict language; only if a structure is SUPPORTED does a verdict leg (does the bridged learner now ride?) become sensible, with its own preregistration; skipping to verdicts would let survival adjudicate a value question (the exact error §3.3 forbids). (5) NO constraint added or dropped — every constraint (evaluation integrity, training-integrity analogue, top-bin composition reporting, smoke-never-evidence, no-ranking, no-collapsing, non-result discipline) traces to a filed lesson.

Next: measurement-leg preregistration drafting phase spawned now (design only — drafts the measurement preregistration from the adopted design; no runs, no leg authorized by the draft; a leg runs only after the parent approves + files that preregistration). If the five-candidate scope is infeasible as one leg, the preregistration phase must propose a scoped first leg with reasons and flag it as a parent call — it must NOT silently narrow the scope.
