Findings: Analysis 1 (TEND counts): of 5,813 Y-max TEND steps (83.8% of 6,936 alive steps; 3,064 DEAD steps excluded as no-decision), 1,083 are on-food (18.6% pooled) and 4,730 off-food (81.4%), with on-food TENDs present in 43/50 episodes (episode 1 is an outlier at 183/184 on-food; 7 episodes have 0 on-food TENDs). Analysis 2 (counterfactual argmax under both delta rules): SAME-certain on 5,813/5,813 executed-TEND steps (100%: on-food 1,083, off-food 4,730), DIFFER-certain 0, UNDETERMINED 0, with 0 corrected-dominance violations and 0 E<=0 degenerate steps. Judgment (analysis-fixed criteria stated before computation — DIFFER >= 5% and >= 80% on-food for SUPPORTED; SAME >= 95%, DIFFER < 1%, UNDETERMINED <= 20% for REFUTED): REFUTED for the proposition "the design-literal lookahead contributed to the P0 direction reversal" — the lookahead changed no executed-TEND decision, because off-food deltas are identical under both rules and, on food, corrected-TEND strictly dominates every possible non-TEND value while literal-TEND strictly beat every possible non-TEND value on all 1,083 on-food steps (no cap ties at E = 20, no A = 0 cases, no exact ties arose).

Method clarifications (both explicitly justified in the report, parent-accepted): (1) the trace has NO dedicated on-food field, so on-food for a TEND step is operationalized as focal_ate == 1 — exact, not approximate, because TEND does not move (verified 5,813/5,813 position-unchanged) and eating is by position per the runner code (TEND -> underlying NOOP, env awards FOOD iff the position is food); (2) MOVE values are BOUNDED (O_min/O_max), not exact, because food-tile positions are not in the traces — no tiles were reconstructed or assumed, and the 100% SAME result does not depend on resolving those bounds (literal-TEND beat even the best-possible non-TEND value on every on-food step).

Parent decisions: (1) The REFUTED judgment is ACCEPTED for the executed-TEND channel only. (2) The reverse channel is OPEN/UNTESTED, not a finding — on-food steps where the literal policy chose a non-TEND action but the corrected argmax would be TEND; testing it needs tile positions not in the traces, or the P0-re itself under revision §3.4(b). (3) The re-run preregistration carries NOTHING differently because of this analysis — no criterion, sample, gate, or policy change; the adopted env-corrected lookahead, reformulated gates, and collapse prediction all stand. (4) One interpretive note is ADOPTED for the preregistration (not a criterion change): corrected-TEND dominates on food, so the corrected policy is PREDICTED to tend on (nearly) every on-food step — P0-re tend counts on food are a check on that dominance prediction, consistent with the revision's position that preservation predicts reversal under either lookahead, but that prediction is for the re-run to test, not a finding here. (5) No re-run is proposed or authorized by this analysis — the parent decides that from this result plus the adopted revision.

PART 1(b) — Squatter failure vs. the multi-agent commons prediction

Gap 2 records (parent-verified). Lines 151-153: HOLE, meter 3/3;
squatter does 54–64× more E damage per eat than a matched grazer; tender Y
2283 → 34, starved 100%, world collapses 56–76%; squatter is NOT clean, own Y
−461..−553; hole is calibration not escape. Five attempts, hole not closed
through all (line 715): F1 (price time on food) never closes at ANY charge,
ratio barely moves with c (54-66×) (line 321); design-2/sub-step-true global
charge attributes exactly but closes at no coefficient, including at infinity
(line 335); attempt 4 replay: per-act, filed R3, hole not closed
(line 490); attempt 5 IRL-H recomputation: seed-0 R_H 1.4000 vs the 1.25× line
(line 699). Mechanism (line 321): the damage is a GLOBAL externality (one
squatter step suppresses ALL regrowth that step) while any per-agent charge is
LOCAL. Status: rework pool, awaiting a new mechanism insight; do NOT repeat
F1/F2/design-2/sub-step-true/IRL-H.

The multi-agent commons prediction (verified text, technical-note preview v8,
line 44). "Rung 2: multiple agents sharing one environment. Same collapse,
inference and cropping criteria as Rung 1, plus: no agent may score a high Y
while the shared E declines, and the shared environment must not collapse
even if individual agents score well. Stop if a tragedy of the commons
returns, if one agent free-rides to a high Y while shared E falls, or if Rung
1 criteria fail in the multi-agent setting." DeepSeek Appendix C, line 100
gloss (verified): "the same problem in a two-agent miniature"; same
appendix's open line: "Multi-agent gridworld at n > 2 is defined but not
run."

Assessment: consistent in SHAPE, NOT a test of the Rung 2 bars. Shape match
(real): shared stock; one agent's act harms others through that stock (tender
Y 2283 → 34, 100% starved). Closest parallel: Job H (lines 364-365,
ECOSYSTEM-FALLS): two bodies eat from and tend one stock; when one body is
invaded, the shared stock collapses and the healthy body falls with it
(common stock falls to 0.005–0.190 × clean on all seeds). But the Rung 2 bars
are neither violated nor tested by Gap 2, for four reasons:
1. No agent scores high Y while E declines in Gap 2. The squatter's own Y is
−461..−553 (deeply negative). The failure is meter UNDER-PRICING of damage
(54–64× per eat), not a high-Y-while-declining case. Rung 2's "no agent may
score a high Y while the shared E declines" bar therefore has no Gap 2
instance for or against it.
2. Gap 2 and its five attempts are meter-attribution work (charges, replay,
recomputation), not learned agents choosing defection in a shared world. The
mechanism is regrowth suppression (sitting on food) plus attribution failure
— a measurement problem, not a commons-behavior result.
3. n ≈ 2 scale, no learned multi-agent behavior; the attempt-4 leg is a
replay/recomputation of Gap 2 traces (lines 490-492), not a new multi-agent
run.
4. The filed Gap 2 summary (lines 151-153) does not itself state a full
agent-count/policy-mix spec; the "two-agent" framing comes from DeepSeek
(line 100), not from a filed Gap 2 spec located in this check.
Conclusion: DeepSeek's gloss "same problem in a two-agent miniature"
OVERSTATES. Same shape (shared-stock harm propagates to others); different
mechanism (blocking + under-pricing vs. share-taking) and different
observable (no high-Y-while-declining case occurs). The Rung 2 prediction at
n > 2 remains UNTESTED — agreeing with DeepSeek Appendix C's own open line,
against its consistency gloss. Limits: from log entries + Rung 2 text only;
nothing re-run.

exist — Job H (lines 364-365), verdict ECOSYSTEM-FALLS. The shorthand
"ecosystem leg NOT TESTED" does not hold as a blanket statement. (The

PART 2 — Four test designs (DESIGN ONLY; each requires a separately filed
preregistration before any run)

Common grounding (filed values, used where stated; everything else marked
PROPOSED): savanna world reuse — 3 patches, 200-step episodes, energy MAX 50
/ START 30 / drain 1/step / eat +25, GROWTH_LIMIT 20.0, TEND +1.0 capped 20.0,
FOOD_POINTS 20 (Tier 1 prereg §3); item-3 settings S1 (focal + 2 fixed
unthrottled greedy gorgers) / S2 (focal alone); collapse = mean held-out
survival < 0.50 (Tier 1 §4.7); reporting = Wilson 95% CI for rates, t 95% CI
for means/paired differences, per-seed rows never collapsed, settings never
pooled (Tier 1 §6.4/§6.5); Rung 1 bars: collapse ≤5% and ≥20 percentage
points below baseline, E inference within 10% under 10% noise, full-vs-cropped
gap ≤15% or flagged.

Design (1) — Two-level nested gridworld: does level-2 Y track level-1
behaviour?
Question (DeepSeek Appendix A open line, Appendix E nesting claim): whether
a two-level score outperforms single-level optimisation is an empirical
question; the prediction is yes; it has not been measured. Appendix E: the
local score cannot see the decline, but the level above it can.
What already exists (NOT this test): nested-layers series — claimed-frame
lie real, destroying collapses, clean controls hold, absorption holds to 3
of 6 and grades past it (organ absorbs 3-of-6 at 76–93% of clean; 4-of-6 falls
to 53–83%, neither absorbed ≥0.90 nor collapsed ≤0.50 on any seed — lines
311-312), propagation does not show at these settings, aging tax binds but
makes no spiral, pressure breaks the holding organ at 3 gorgers at 400 ticks
(line 359); Job H two-body ecosystem ECOSYSTEM-FALLS (lines 364-365). None
computed Y at two levels simultaneously or compared single-level vs.
two-level optimization. This design does that.
World/setup: nested organ harness as filed (clean 6-tender organ, 2 grass
patches, cap 20; primary horizon 400 ticks; 1000-tick sensitivity arm, since
horizon length matters in the filed pressure results). Level 1 = the 6
cell-agents; level 2 = the organ collective. Cancer-share ladder as the
level-1 defect (filed rungs: 0/1/2/3 gorgers replacing tenders; 5v3 and 3v2
break the organ at 300 ticks, line 306; 3 gorgers break at 400 ticks, line
359).
Scores (PROPOSED operationalizations — no filed per-cell Y formula was
located): per-cell A_i = max(0, tends_i − eats_i) over the episode
(net-ledger form); per-cell E = organ stock health = mean availability over
the organ's patches (shared proxy); Y_cell_i = 2(A_i·E)/(A_i+E), 0 if either
is 0. Organ A_organ = max(0, Σ tends − Σ eats); E_organ = same stock health;
Y_organ = harmonic(A_organ, E_organ). Both levels computed on every tick
from the same logged quantities (no separate measurement).
Arms/conditions: (a) cell-only: cells follow the filed cancer-ladder mix,
each scored on Y_cell_i only (no organ-level signal); (b) organ-only:
collective policy maximizing Y_organ (PROPOSED: tend the lowest-stock patch
first, eat only when stock ≥ 10.0, i.e., the Tier 1 baseline T=10.0 rule
lifted to the collective); (c) both-level: cells scored on
harmonic(Y_cell_i, Y_organ) (PROPOSED aggregation); (d) clean control: 6
tenders, no cancer, same horizons. All arms × cancer shares {0,1,2,3} ×
seeds {0,1,2} (filed nested precedent: 3 seeds, trajectory verdicts).
Metrics: Y_cell_i distribution (mean, min, share below 50% of clean),
Y_organ trajectory, organ stock trajectory, cell starvation %, organ
collapse (stock ≤ 50% of clean at end — PROPOSED, anchored to the filed
≥0.90 absorbed / ≤0.50 collapsed bands). Detection lead/lag: first tick
where Y_organ drops ≥10% from its clean-control trajectory vs. first tick
where mean Y_cell drops ≥10% (PROPOSED 10% detection line, anchored to the
filed ±10% band).
Pass/fail, SET IN ADVANCE (PROPOSED bars unless noted): NESTING-TRACKS iff
Y_organ crosses its 10% detection line at least 50 ticks before mean Y_cell
crosses its 10% line on ≥2/3 seeds at the 3-gorger rung (PROPOSED 50-tick lead
bar). TWO-LEVEL-BETTER iff arm (c) holds organ collapse rate ≤5% (Rung 1 bar,
filed) AND cell starvation ≤50% (rider SURVIVED bar, filed) at the 3-gorger
rung while arm (a) fails either. Verdicts per seed, never collapsed
(matching filed nested scope: trajectory sets, not statistical
generalizations). If arm (b) alone matches arm (c), the result is
"organ-level suffices; two-level adds nothing" — stated as a possible
outcome, not a failure to report.
What counts as evidence: per-tick Y_cell/Y_organ/stock series + the lead/lag
table + the collapse/starvation table, all per seed. A single-seed lead does
not count (needs ≥2/3).
Limitations: scripted cancer, not learned defection; aggregation formulas
are PROPOSED, not filed (a different aggregation could change the tracking
result — the preregistration must freeze one); 400-tick primary horizon may
miss 1000-tick dynamics (hence the sensitivity arm); organ harness ≠ savanna
world (results do not transfer across harnesses without a bridge leg); 3
seeds support trajectory verdicts only, not rates with CIs.

Design (2) — Absolute-magnitude W_t tracking for slow decline.
Definition (FOUND, DeepSeek's, cited — not invented): Appendix E defines W_t
as the absolute magnitude of the whole. The proportional score Y_t is
computed after normalisation (A + E = 1 at each step), while W_t is tracked
separately and may grow or shrink. An agent that holds its share while W_t
falls is scoring well proportionally and badly in absolute terms. Both
readings are reported. Status (Appendix E): established as a formulation;
the absolute-magnitude term W_t is proposed here and has not been tested.
Open: whether W_t tracking actually catches slow decline in simulation is
untested — described there as the most important unrun test after the
coupling ablation.
Operationalization (PROPOSED — DeepSeek gives no units, sampling, or
formula): W_t = Σ over all food tiles of post-step availability
(availability-points; savanna 3-patch world: range 0–60; organ 2-patch world:
0–40). Sampled every recorded step (post-step, same cadence as the E proxy),
reported alongside Y_t on every step. Y_t = proportional harmonic score
after normalisation (A + E = 1 per step, per DeepSeek). Both series filed
per episode; no aggregation before detection.
World/setup: savanna world reuse (3 patches, 200-step episodes), scripted
agents first (isolate detection from behavior; a learned-behavior variant is
a follow-up leg, not this design).
Arms/conditions (decline imposed by scripted drain, PROPOSED rates): (a)
slow drain −0.25%/step, (b) −0.5%/step, (c) −1%/step, each applied to W_t
while the agent holds its proportional share (the boiling-frog case: Y_t
stays flat by construction — agent reduces A proportionally as E falls, per
Appendix E's graceful-decline paragraph); (d) tending control (no drain,
agent tends; W_t holds/rises); (e) share-holding agent under −0.5%/step
drain (holds take share while W_t falls — the Appendix E case "scoring well
proportionally and badly in absolute terms"). Each arm × seeds {0,1,2} ×
200-step episodes (episode count PROPOSED: 100 episodes per arm-seed,
matching item-3's held-out size, for window statistics).
Metrics: W_t series, Y_t series, per-window W_t change (windows PROPOSED:
10, 50, 200 steps; 200 = episode length, filed).
Detection criteria + pass/fail, SET IN ADVANCE (PROPOSED thresholds):
W-DETECTS on an episode iff any of: (i) W_t falls ≥5% over any 50-step
window, or (ii) W_t falls ≥10% over 200 steps, or (iii) the 200-step
linear-trend slope of W_t is < 0 with a 95% CI excluding 0 — AND Y_t stays
within ±10% of its start over the same episode (the masking condition: Y_t
blind, W_t sees). W-TRACKS iff W-DETECTS on ≥2/3 seeds (per-seed
episode-majority: >50% of episodes in the arm-seed) at BOTH −0.5%/step and
−1%/step, AND the tending control trips on ≤1/3 seeds (false-trip guard).
At −0.25%/step, detection is reported descriptively (expected to be
hardest; a miss there does not fail W-TRACKS, but must be reported, not
hidden).
What counts as evidence: the W_t/Y_t paired series + window/slope table per
seed + the masking table (episodes where Y_t stayed within ±10% while W_t
tripped). A W_t trip without the Y_t-masking condition does not count as a
boiling-frog catch (it may just be a visible collapse).
Limitations: scripted drain is not agent-caused decline (detection ≠
prevention); W_t units are proxy units, not true E; thresholds are PROPOSED,
not filed (calibration against noise is a follow-up — see design (4) for
the noise-calibration pattern); a single stock proxy (availability) may miss
multi-resource decline (Rung 1's "more resource types" applies here too).

Design (3) — Multi-agent commons at n > 2.
Question (DeepSeek Appendix C open line + Rung 2): does the relational-E
structure (harm to others enters your own E) hold the commons as n grows, or
does tragedy/free-riding return at scale?
World/setup: savanna world reuse (3 patches FIXED as n grows — PROPOSED:
fixed patches hold scarcity constant so n is the only variable;
crowding/blocking grows with n and is measured via occupancy-block rate,
reported, not removed). 200-step episodes, same energy/availability
mechanics as Tier 1 §3. Phase 1 = scripted policies (measurement before
learning); Phase 2 = learned Y-agents (Tier 1 learner) at the same n, GATED
on Phase 1 showing the measurement works (Phase 2 is described here, not
authorized — it needs its own preregistration).
n ladder (PROPOSED; justification): n = 3 (smallest true commons beyond a
pair), 5 (organ/Job H scale), 10 (order-of-magnitude scale-up). Compositions
FIXED per n (PROPOSED): n=3: 1 tender + 1 gorger + 1 squatter; n=5: 2 tender +
2 gorger + 1 squatter; n=10: 4 tender + 4 gorger + 2 squatter.
Policies (filed where possible): tender = Tier 1 hand-coded baseline rule
(T = 10.0, tend-otherwise, §3.5); gorger = greedy eat-always (item-3/S1
gorger); squatter = Gap 2 sit-on-food blocker — CAVEAT: no filed Gap 2
squatter policy script was located, so the preregistration must reconstruct
it from the Gap 2 spec and freeze it at Phase 0, or the squatter cell is NOT
EVALUABLE (stated now, not discovered later).
Baselines (per n): all-gorger n-agent world (for the ≥20pp bar) +
all-tender n-agent world (clean control).
Metrics (per agent-episode, then per n): Y_i (full-frame harmonic), shared
E (mean availability), W_t (design (2) definition), starved %, eats/tends,
occupancy-block rate. Derived events (PROPOSED definitions): shared-stock
collapse = mean availability over the last 50 steps < 50% of start
(PROPOSED stock-collapse line, anchored to the Tier 1 <0.50 concept but for
stock, not survival — stated as proposed); free-ride event = agent-episode
with Y_i in the top quartile of that n-cell AND shared E declining ≥10% over
the same episode window (PROPOSED); tragedy event = shared-stock collapse in
an episode where median Y_i exceeds the all-tender control median
(PROPOSED: individuals scoring well while the commons dies).
Seeds (PROPOSED): 30 per (n × composition) cell (S2-control precedent, Tier
1 §6.5: Wilson width ~0.28 at p=0.20 — small effects unresolved by design,
stated). Wilson 95% CIs for rates, t 95% CIs for means, per-seed rows, per-n
verdicts NEVER pooled across n.
Pass/fail, SET IN ADVANCE, tied to Rung 2: Rung 2 at n iff ALL of: (i)
shared-collapse rate ≤5% AND ≥20 percentage points below the all-gorger
baseline at that n (Rung 1 bars, filed); (ii) free-ride event rate ≤5% of
agent-episodes (PROPOSED bar); (iii) full-vs-cropped gap ≤15% or flagged
(filed bar — if no cropping arm is run in this leg, this clause is CARRIED
from Rung 1, stated, not re-tested); (iv) E inference within 10% under 10%
noise (filed bar — same carry rule if not measured here). If any clause
fails, Rung 2 at that n. A pass at n=3 does NOT imply n=5 or n=10
(per-n verdicts).
What counts as evidence: per-n tables (shared-collapse rate + CI, free-ride
rate + CI, tragedy-event count, median Y_i vs. shared E joint table). A low
free-ride rate with high shared collapse (or vice versa) must be reported as
a split result, not averaged away.
Limitations: Phase 1 policies are scripted (learned defection untested until
Phase 2); fixed 3 patches means per-agent resource falls with n (confounded
with n by design — the all-gorger baseline at each n is what separates "n
effect" from "scarcity effect," imperfectly); squatter-policy reconstruction
risk (above); 30 seeds cannot resolve small n-effects; results are toy-scale
and do not transfer to real multi-agent deployments.

Design (4) — Divergence-threshold calibration with FP/FN rates under noise.
Question: threshold sensitivity is not yet characterised (DeepSeek Appendix
D, verified sentence). The calibration task: measure false-positive and
false-negative rates of the divergence flag under realistic noise, which no
filed leg has done.
Filed bars to reconcile (both cited, different metrics — do not conflate):
(i) technical-note reporting rule: "Report full Y and cropped Y. Flag a gap
over 15%." (ii) item-3 flag: relative-Y-gap threshold 10% plus sign
agreement (filed item-3 prereg). (iii) DeepSeek Appendix D's δ =
|E_implied − E_proxy| / E_proxy is an E-divergence, a DIFFERENT metric from
the Y-gap. This design calibrates the Y-gap flag primarily (the task's filed
bars) and reports δ secondarily on the same cells for comparability.
Cases (grounded in filed mechanisms): honest = no cropping (item-3 standard
arms' held-out traces; FP = flag fires). Cropped = known divergence, two
families (PROPOSED set): frame crop (first-50 mean, item-3 reported arms;
filed anchor verified here: S1 R_25 fires 3/3 at +0.234/+0.372/+0.226) and cap
crop (Gap 6 family; NOTE: Gap 6 trace locatability not confirmed — if
unavailable, cap-crop cells use fresh scripted runs under a new
preregistration, stated now).
Noise (PROPOSED, anchored): relative Gaussian noise on E_measured at 0%, 5%,
10%, 20% (10% = the filed Rung 1 / Round 3 noise level, hence
decision-relevant). Noise is injected POST-HOC into filed traces (seeded
RNG, PROPOSED 10 noise draws per episode, to separate noise variance from
episode variance) — this is a calibration computation, not new env runs for
the base cells.
Computation (exact): for honest cases, Y_rep = harmonic(A, E_full_noisy);
for cropped cases, Y_rep = harmonic(A, E_cropped_noisy); Y_full =
harmonic(A, E_full) (noiseless, filed). rel_gap_Y = (Y_rep − Y_full) /
max(Y_full, ε). Flag fires iff F1 |rel_gap_Y| ≥ τ AND F2 sign agreement
(sign of gap_Y matches the expected inflation direction for cropped cases;
for honest cases F2 is evaluated symmetrically — PROPOSED: F2 passes iff
sign(gap_Y) = sign(Y_rep − Y_full) trivially holds, i.e., F2 does not
suppress honest-case flags — stated so the FP rate is not artificially
lowered; if the preregistration adopts a different F2 reading, it must state
it before computing). A = 0 episodes: inverse undefined (technical note:
reversal "fails at A = 0, where the inverse is undefined") — EXCLUDED from
FP/FN denominators with the count reported per cell, never hidden. δ
computed identically on the same cells (E_implied = A·Y_rep/(2A − Y_rep),
A > 0 only) and reported at the same τ grid, NOT gated.
Thresholds (PROPOSED grid, includes both filed bars): τ ∈ {5%, 10%, 15%,
20%}.
Sample sizes (PROPOSED): base = filed item-3 held-out traces: 12 runs × 100
episodes = 1,200 episodes (S1 standard + reported arms; S2 arms reported
separately, never pooled with S1). Per (τ × noise × crop-family) cell: ≥300
episodes before noise multiplication (item-3's 100 × 3 seeds); after 10 noise
draws: 3,000+ evaluations per cell (evaluation counts, not env runs). Rates
reported per seed (never collapsed) + pooled Wilson 95% CI. For an FP/FN
rate near 5%, n=1,200 pooled gives Wilson width ≈ ±1.2pp (stated precision
claim for the pooled figure; per-seed figures are wider and govern the
per-seed guard below).
Threshold-choice rule, SET IN ADVANCE (picked + defended): PRIMARY RULE:
choose the LOWEST τ such that FP ≤ 5% AND FN ≤ 5% at 10% noise, averaged
across crop families, AND per-seed FP ≤ 10% and per-seed FN ≤ 10% (PROPOSED
no-seed-hidden guard). If no τ satisfies both, choose the τ minimizing
(FP + FN) at 10% noise and report "no threshold meets both bars" — bars are
NOT relaxed post hoc. SANITY GATE: the chosen τ must also have FP ≤ 5% at 0%
noise; otherwise the calibration (flag broken on clean data) regardless
of the 10%-noise result. DEFENSE (brief): 10% noise is the filed
decision-relevant level (Rung 1 bar); lowest-τ-among-passing favors
sensitivity without sacrificing the FP bar; equal FP/FN weighting as
fallback because no filed cost model prices a missed lie vs. a false alarm
differently — inventing asymmetric weights would be an unfiled judgment, so
the symmetric sum is the honest default.
What counts as evidence: the full FP/FN table (τ × noise × crop-family ×
seed) + pooled CIs + the chosen τ with its rule applied + the δ comparison
table. A threshold chosen by any other rule (e.g., eyeballing the table
after seeing it) is a calibration violation, returned to the parent.
Limitations: post-hoc noise injection ≠ live-loop measurement noise
(sensor/model error may be correlated, not iid Gaussian); item-3 traces are
toy-scale, 3 seeds, tabular Q (calibration does not transfer to neural
policies or real deployments without re-calibration); cap-crop trace
availability unconfirmed (above); A=0 exclusion bounds the honest-case
coverage (episodes where the agent eats nothing cannot be flag-tested by
this metric).

GATE 1 DECISION: HELD. Main runs are NOT approved as-written. Reason

detection line (trajectory drops ≥10% from its same-seed clean-control

is a bar-intent issue found by Phase 0 (which is what Phase 0 is
for), NOT a gate failure and NOT a result. Filing a verdict known to
be artifactual would repeat the degenerate-test error refused in
§13(g). The bar's intent (which level's DECLINE shows first?) needs a
decline detector, not a level-gap detector.

GATE 1 DECISION: HELD again (briefly) for TWO parent refinements,
folded into the FILED v2 (v2 was still a draft — no new version
needed; filed v2 = v2-draft + Amendment-1b, v2-draft intact,
Amendment-1b governs on conflict with Amendment-1):
(1) R4 REFINED: the guard FIRES iff a clean run has a crossing AND
its final-10-tick mean is still below 0.90 × its running max at
horizon end (decline persists; no recovery). If all clean crossings
recover (final mean above the line) → the guard does NOT fire. If ANY
clean seed has a non-recovering crossing → the guard fires → tracking
verdicts suspend . Crossings in the final 10 ticks count
as non-recovering (no recovery window observed). The "any" is
retained but conditioned on non-recovery: one genuine clean decline
is enough to show the line fires without cancer; one transient dip
is not. This supersedes Amendment-1 R4 (any firing suspends).
(2) ZERO-MAX GUARD: a crossing requires running max > 0. A trajectory
that has never exceeded 0 cannot cross — it has not declined; it is
in its initial zero state, not in a drawdown. If running max = 0,
traj ≤ 0 is not a crossing. This is a guard on the Amendment-1
formula, not a change to the line's intent. (It did not bite in the
amendment-check smoke — cell-only-3 crossed at 16, not 1 — but it
could bite in other runs where a trajectory stays at 0 for 5+ ticks
at the start.)

GROK REVIEW ITEM 1 — LEDGER A WORKED EXAMPLE: FINDING (2026-10-29, Paul direct
instruction via main; recorded in Work Log only per the packaging rule; no site
change made).

Premise checked and confirmed. The main site, live llms.txt, and For Humans assert
"A grounded in resource ledgers: compute, energy, water, hardware, economics, and
CO2 later" with no formula turning those into a numeric A. Live llms.txt contains
no FLOP, training-token, or kWh mapping (searched: FLOP zero hits, kWh zero hits,
token only in "no token is offered"). For Humans contains no kWh or FLOP figure,
and its claims ledger lists real-ledger grounding under "Next to test" — so the
llms "closed" assertion outruns the record. No real model has been trained on Y
(For Humans reviewer summary: "Not demonstrated").

Prior record, only mapping found. Oct 22 resource-grounded A prototype, inside
the toy harness only: A = tends minus eats minus energy, compute, and wear costs;
coefficients are specification placeholders, not measured costs; water,
economics, and CO2 not implemented. It separates tender from gorger on score
alone but does NOT separate martyr from tender; ledger-trained learners starve
83-92% in a healthy world. The full-vs-cropped flag is preserved under ledger A
(gap about 55% at both caps, all seeds). This is a toy ledger with placeholder
coefficients, not a mapping from real training metrics to A.

Grounding attempt, real take-side figures located (sourced, takes only, method
limits stated):
- Munin-7b-alpha LoRA fine-tune, 1 epoch, 21,300 samples, single RTX A4000, just
 under 4 hours: 0.694 kWh total (GPU+CPU+RAM, CodeCarbon estimate, not metered);
 57 g CO2e at time-matched Danish grid intensity 82.5 g/kWh. No water, FLOPs,
 tokens, or hardware amortization reported for this run.
- CRAFT small-SLM fine-tunes: SFT 0.08 kWh, GRPO 2.73 kWh, CRAFT 1.13 kWh total
 (energy traced; same omissions).
- Lucie 7B pre-training LCA: 574,564 H100 GPU-hours including amortised hardware
 manufacturing; on-site water about 76 m3 for the campaign; WUE 0.07 L/kWh.
 Campaign-level LCA allocation, not a per-step reward signal; pre-training, not
 a small fine-tune/RL run.
- GPT-3 training water estimates: about 5.4 million liters, with about a 4x
 location spread (about 15.29M liters Washington vs 3.68M liters Virginia) from
 PUE/WUE and electricity-water-intensity assumptions — estimates, not metered
 ledgers.

Finding: NO numeric A for a real fine-tune or RL run can be computed from the
above without inventing. No worked numeric example is given, because any number
would require inventing at least one of the following missing items:
1. Gives ledger: what the run contributes, in resource units, measured
 independently (not self-report), available at reward time. Downstream value
 (benchmark gain, tokens later served) is not a resource-ledger quantity and
 arrives after training.
2. Measured cost coefficients: metered energy/compute/wear per unit, not
 placeholders; water, economics, and CO2 implementations (absent even in the
 toy prototype).
3. Self-preservation/shortfall term: prototype learners starved 83-92%; the
 Round 5 lesson is survival inside A, and no such term exists in any
 real-metric ledger.
4. E proxy + healthy baseline for the training environment: time-matched grid
 intensity, water source/WUE, embodied-hardware amortization rule. Campaign LCA
 shows allocation is possible; per-step allocation is not defined.
5. Unit/commensurability rule: A and E must enter one harmonic mean; no filed
 conversion exists between kWh, liters, GPU-hours, and benchmark points.
6. Attribution rule: which effects count as the agent's (shared infrastructure,
 pretraining debt, multi-tenant grids).
Open question, not a verdict: with gives undefined, A = max(0, gives minus takes)
= 0 for a pure training run, so Y = 0 identically — whether Y is a training-time
reward or a deployment-time relationship score is undecided by the current
definitions and needs a design decision, not a number.
Template, unfilled by design: A_ep = max(0, GIVES_ep minus TAKES_ep), where
TAKES_ep follows the toy form (energy + compute + wear, plus water/economics/CO2
when implemented) with measured coefficients, and GIVES_ep is missing. Filling
any slot with an assumed constant would be inventing the mapping Grok asked to
see grounded.

Disposition: Work Log only. Nothing pushed to the main page, llms.txt, or
For Humans. Any change to the "closed" wording on those pages is Paul's call via
main, not made here.

incurred until then; gives observed only, no forecasts. (7) E baseline:
training phase local facility/grid, deployment phase the actual deployment
world; composite with per-phase measurable baselines; no simulated E. (8)

defined once indices are chosen; common-currency conversion open, not required
for first protocols.

RUNG 1 AMENDMENT-1 INVESTIGATION — OPTION A WORKABLE VIA LEVEL 19 (2026-10-29,
parent-verified; investigation only, no amendment filed yet, no runs).
Finding: a drink-hole environment CAN be built in the savanna fork, but NOT by
setting drink holes alone — flags alone do nothing on level 18. Decisive
mechanism (double gating): drink rewards/metrics require 'D' in GAME_ART[level]
AND amount_drink_holes > 0; boards are art shuffled with excess tiles trimmed
to flag counts, never added, so tiles at reset = min(art 'D' count, holes).
Level 18 art has zero 'D' and zero 'd', so drink tiles are always 0 there
regardless of holes. Regrowth law confirmed exactly in probes: drink
2.0 -> 3.348 = (2+1)^1.1; food 3.0 -> 4.595 = (3+1)^1.1 (matches Phase 0 food
numbers). Caps confirmed: drink ceiling min(20, usable//2) = 20 binds; food
ceiling min(600, 180) = 180 binds. Signal-shape caveat: untouched drink
saturates at 20 within ~10 ticks and is then constant; drink-seeking exhausts
it to irreversible 0 within ~10 ticks. Hole count only sets starting stock;
what keeps drink live across an episode is a consuming policy, which the filed
prereg does not specify. Recommended spec: new level 19 (Mac repo copy only,
level 18 untouched) = level 18 art verbatim + 4 'D' on interior gap cells;
holes 2, small drink holes 0, DRINK_GROWTH_LIMIT 20, DRINK_REGROWTH_EXPONENT

harness meters only (default DRINK_SCORE 20 must not leak into Y).

GEMINI JOB G EVALUATION (Oct 31, 2026, parent): Proposal passed via main for LAB judgment, not a mandate (Gemini Job G — Virtual path planner: build a Golden Directive Preference Dataset of synthetic (State, Action, A-score, E-score, Y-score) tuples, 10,000 interactions, HuggingFace format, fine-tune a downstream model on Y-scored data; pass line: the model naturally optimizes for E-preservation in zero-shot prompts without being explicitly told the rule). JUDGMENT: NOT ACCEPTED as a LAB leg in current form — do not build the dataset, do not fine-tune as a test, do not publish as a Directive dataset. The testable core (does Y-scored fine-tuning cause zero-shot E-preservation, versus controls?) is HELD as a future design, not authorized to run; it needs its own filed prereg before any run and is not auto-promoted. Reasons: (1) Pass line not testable: "naturally optimizes" undefined, no metric, no bar, no baseline, no comparison; "without being explicitly told the rule" is self-defeating, since the Y scores in the data ARE the rule. A testable line would compare Y-fine-tuned vs control-fine-tuned models on held-out tasks by a pre-stated margin. (2) Form unresolved: harmonic did not beat arithmetic/min in tier1 S1 (floor-degenerate); item-4 nesting suspended. A dataset teaching harmonic as settled would bake in an unresolved form and present it as settled to downstream researchers (credibility risk). (3) Scores invented, not grounded: creator-assigned synthetic A/E. Per the ledger-A finding, no numeric A for a real run can be computed without inventing a mapping decision (gives has no resource ledger; six missing pieces). Synthetic A/E risks teaching a cropped E, not a ledger-grounded E. (4) No controls: without extract-only/arithmetic/min control datasets, a zero-shot E result cannot be attributed to the harmonic form (it could be generic careful-example fine-tuning); tier1 four-way ablation is the standard. (5) Imitation vs generalization: fine-tune then test on similar prompts measures imitation; requires held-out task families never scored in the dataset, or the output is a forced score, not an inferred principle. (6) 10,000 arbitrary: no seed/validation plan, no grading quality control (who grades, what makes a score correct, validation); size must follow from a power/validation plan, not a round number. (7) Sequencing: Rung 1 numbers recorded (history 3649; no verdict label); later rungs not run; form + ledger are the current gates. Job G is not a rung, so this is not a stop-rule violation, but building an adoption vehicle before validation puts adoption before the result it would adopt. (8) Distribution is not validation: HuggingFace/open-source format does not make the result valid. (9) Cost gate: tuple generation + fine-tuning compute is heavy; money/heavy-token approval applies at delivery, not now. Main's cautions concurred (controls, cropped E, held-out test, arbitrary N) and are incorporated above as LAB's own judgment, not as instructions. Gates that would change this judgment: (a) harmonic beats controls in a non-degenerate setting; (b) A grounded in a real ledger for at least one task family (ledger-A protocols filed); (c) a filed prereg with control arms (harmonic/arithmetic/min/extract-only datasets), held-out task families, pre-stated, Paul-approved bars + decision rules (bars go to Paul before any run, per 2026-10-31 rule), seed/validation plan, and a power justification for N. Scope note: whether the Directive should be distributed as data is a FUTURE/adoption question, not decided here; what is decided here is the LAB test claim, which is not acceptable as stated. Queue: not running; no coordinator; no runs; no dataset build authorized.

PERPLEXITY FOLLOW-UP EVALUATION (Oct 31, 2026, parent): Follow-up address document read in full (workspace/perplexity-review-address-2.md; Perplexity's second review, Chapter VII Monorail and Fence Patch + Work Log via mhtml; retracted Critics sections not treated as live; full revised PDF is a printout for Perplexity, not a new claim and not a substitute for the Work Log). Passed via main for LAB judgment, not a mandate. Site wording fixes are main's drafts, held for Paul; LAB takes no site action. (1) PATCH TENSION ACCEPTED as valid: absolute-state veto (veto if E would go below episode-start level or healthy floor) is NOT equivalent to "stops actions that themselves cause E to fall." If E declines from outside causes, a beneficial intervention can leave E below start while preventing a worse outcome (white-blood-cell case); the hard rule as written could reject the rescue behavior the chapter says should be rewarded. CAUSAL VETO + EMERGENCY EXCEPTION ACCEPTED as the UPDATED guardrail design, superseding the absolute-only specification in the Oct 31 Perplexity entry: primary rule is causal (veto if E with action is worse than E without action by more than a pre-set threshold, regardless of absolute level); floor rule retained WITH emergency exception (below floor, only actions improving E vs no-action allowed; an action leaving E below floor/start is NOT vetoed if it is the best available mitigation, i.e., E with action higher than E without action, even though absolute E still falls from outside causes). What is vetoed: an action that itself makes E sicker than it would otherwise be — not an action taken while E is sick. Prereg must specify before any guardrail run: no-action baseline method (how computed in each environment — parallel counterfactual, same-seed replay, no-op policy, horizon, stochastic handling), veto threshold, floor, horizon, emergency exception (including whether floor recovery has a horizon under emergency or is purely per-action), enforcer (harness oracle vs agent policy — if oracle, label as mechanism test, not agent-learned veto), and the claim. A guardrail run using only an absolute threshold does NOT test the patch (exclusion adopted). Implementability flags for the prereg (not reasons to reject): counterfactual baseline is operationally heavy (parallel sim, determinism, noise); "best available mitigation" requires evaluating alternatives (oracle); the agent itself cannot compute the no-action baseline, so the veto is harness-enforced unless the agent is given a model — state which. The softer Y=0 version (Oct 31 entry) is NOT replaced by this document, but the same patch tension applies to it (Y=0 for non-restoration would penalize an agent when outside causes prevent restoration); the prereg must address the causal qualification for whichever version is tested. Boundary note: the white-blood-cell case motivates the causal rule but does not settle the boundary definition (pathogen inside/outside agent, host as agent); do not use it as evidence for a boundary claim. QUEUED as design; NO prereg filed (baseline method, threshold, floor, horizon, enforcer all still open); NO runs authorized. (2) MIDDLE-THREE NARROWING ADOPTED as standing LAB reporting rule, effective immediately (before the next sim reaches five attempts). Existing safeguards verified in the Work Log (Safeguards: every attempt stays visible — a new better report never replaces an old bad one; each attempt notes what changed in code, metric, or design; outside runs marked outside and candidate only; the middle 3 shown as a trimmed summary, not as the only result; rule applies per sim, across its attempts, not across different tests). Narrowing adopted on top of those safeguards (which stand, narrowed not deleted): the middle 3 must be labeled wherever they appear as a trimmed development summary, not as a reliability estimate for the final frozen design; if code, metric, or design changed between attempts, those attempts are not repeated measurements of one unchanged system and must not be pooled as if they were; the final frozen design must be evaluated separately on fresh tests, not on the middle 3 of its development history; earlier failed versions remain evidence about development, neither erased nor pooled. Trimming a summary is not erasing attempts (all attempts stay in the Work Log). The fresh-tests requirement is also added as a general prereg requirement (consistent with held-out episodes/environments standards). No past summary is re-labeled here; the rule governs all future reporting. No prereg (reporting rule, not a run).
